text: My son, from heaven all this will come upon the earth, and upon the earth there will be great destruction.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: After that I arose and prayed and implored and besought, and wrote down my prayer for the generations of the world, and I will show everything to thee, my son Methuselah.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And when I had gone forth below and seen the heaven, and the sun rising in the east, and the moon setting in the west, and a few stars, and the whole earth, and everything as †He had known† it in the beginning, then I blessed the Lord of judgement and extolled Him because He had made the sun to go forth from the windows of the east, †and he ascended and rose on the face of the heaven, and set out and kept traversing the path shown unto him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I lifted up my hands in righteousness and blessed the Holy and Great One, and spake with the breath of my mouth, and with the tongue of flesh, which God has made for the children of the flesh of men, that they should speak therewith, and He gave them breath and a tongue and a mouth that they should speak therewith:

title: 1 Enoch
text: ‘Blessed be Thou, O Lord, King, Great and mighty in Thy greatness, Lord of the whole creation of the heaven, King of kings and God of the whole world.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And Thy power and kingship and greatness abide for ever and ever, And throughout all generations Thy dominion: And all the heavens are Thy throne for ever, And the whole earth Thy footstool for ever and ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For Thou hast made and Thou rulest all things, And nothing is too hard for Thee, Wisdom departs not =from the place of Thy throne=, =Nor turns away= from Thy presence. And Thou knowest and seest and hearest everything, And there is nothing hidden from Thee [for Thou seest everything].

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now the angels of Thy heavens are guilty of trespass, And upon the flesh of men abideth Thy wrath until the great day of judgement.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now, O God and Lord and Great King, I implore and beseech Thee to fulfil my prayer, To leave me a posterity on earth, And not to destroy all the flesh of man, And make the earth without inhabitant, So that there should be an eternal destruction.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now, my Lord, destroy from the earth the flesh which has aroused Thy wrath, But the flesh of righteousness and uprightness establish as a plant of the eternal seed, And hide not Thy face from the prayer of Thy servant, O Lord.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: LXXXV-XC. _The Second Dream-Vision of Enoch: the History of the World to the Founding of the Messianic Kingdom._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after this I saw another dream, and I will show the whole dream to thee, my son.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And Enoch lifted up (his voice) and spake to his son Methuselah: ‘To thee, my son, will I speak: hear my words—incline thine ear to the dream-vision of thy father.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Before I took thy mother Edna, I saw in a vision on my bed, and behold a bull came forth from the earth, and that bull was white; and after it came forth a heifer, and along with this (latter) came forth two bulls, one of them black and the other red.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that black bull gored the red one and pursued him over the earth, and thereupon I could no longer see that red bull.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But that black bull grew and that heifer went with him, and I saw that many oxen proceeded from him which resembled and followed him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that cow, that first one, went from the presence of that first bull in order to seek that red one, but found him not, and lamented with a great lamentation over him and sought him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I looked till that first bull came to her and quieted her, and from that time onward she cried no more.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that she bore another white bull, and after him she bore many bulls and black cows.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw in my sleep that white bull likewise grow and become a great white bull, and from him proceeded many white bulls, and they resembled him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they began to beget many white bulls, which resembled them, one following the other, (even) many.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Fall of the Angels and the Demoralization of Mankind._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And again I saw with mine eyes as I slept, and I saw the heaven above, and behold a star fell from heaven, and it arose and ate and pastured amongst those oxen.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that I saw the large and the black oxen, and behold they all changed their stalls and pastures and their cattle, and began to live with each other.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And again I saw in the vision, and looked towards the heaven, and behold I saw many stars descend and cast themselves down from heaven to that first star, and they became bulls amongst those cattle and pastured with them [amongst them].

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I looked at them and saw, and behold they all let out their privy members, like horses, and began to cover the cows of the oxen, and they all became pregnant and bare elephants, camels and asses.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all the oxen feared them and were affrighted at them, and began to bite with their teeth and to devour, and to gore with their horns.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they began moreover to devour those oxen; and behold all the children of the earth began to tremble and quake before them and to flee from them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Advent of the Seven Archangels._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And again I saw how they began to gore each other and to devour each other, and the earth began to cry aloud.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I raised mine eyes again to heaven, and I saw in the vision, and behold there came forth from heaven beings who were like white men: and four went forth from that place and three with them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And those three that had last come forth grasped me by my hand and took me up, away from the generations of the earth, and raised me up to a lofty place, and showed me a tower raised high above the earth, and all the hills were lower.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And one said unto me: ‘Remain here till thou seest everything that befalls those elephants, camels, and asses, and the stars and the oxen, and all of them.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Punishment of the Fallen Angels by the Archangels._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw one of those four who had come forth first, and he seized that first star which had fallen from the heaven, and bound it hand and foot and cast it into an abyss: now that abyss was narrow and deep, and horrible and dark.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And one of them drew a sword, and gave it to those elephants and camels and asses: then they began to smite each other, and the whole earth quaked because of them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And as I was beholding in the vision, lo, one of the four who had come forth stoned (them) from heaven, and gathered and took all the great stars whose privy members were like those of horses, and bound them all hand and foot, and cast them in an abyss of the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 1-9. _The Deluge and the Deliverance of Noah._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And one of those four went to that white bull and instructed him in a secret, without his being terrified: he was born a bull and became a man, and built for himself a great vessel and dwelt thereon; and three bulls dwelt with him in that vessel and they were covered in.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And again I raised mine eyes towards heaven and saw a lofty roof, with seven water torrents thereon, and those torrents flowed with much water into an enclosure.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw again, and behold fountains were opened on the surface of that great enclosure, and that water began to swell and rise upon the surface, and I saw that enclosure till all its surface was covered with water.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the water, the darkness, and mist increased upon it; and as I looked at the height of that water, that water had risen above the height of that enclosure, and was streaming over that enclosure, and it stood upon the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all the cattle of that enclosure were gathered together until I saw how they sank and were swallowed up and perished in that water.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But that vessel floated on the water, while all the oxen and elephants and camels and asses sank to the bottom with all the animals, so that I could no longer see them, and they were not able to escape, (but) perished and sank into the depths.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And again I saw in the vision till those water torrents were removed from that high roof, and the chasms of the earth were levelled up and other abysses were opened.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then the water began to run down into these, till the earth became visible; but that vessel settled on the earth, and the darkness retired and light appeared.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But that white bull which had become a man came out of that vessel, and the three bulls with him, and one of those three was white like that bull, and one of them was red as blood, and one black: and that white bull departed from them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 10-27. _From the Death of Noah to the Exodus._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they began to bring forth beasts of the field and birds, so that there arose different genera: lions, tigers, wolves, dogs, hyenas, wild boars, foxes, squirrels, swine, falcons, vultures, kites, eagles, and ravens; and among them was born a white bull.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they began to bite one another; but that white bull which was born amongst them begat a wild ass and a white bull with it, and the wild asses multiplied.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But that bull which was born from him begat a black wild boar and a white sheep; and the former begat many boars, but that sheep begat twelve sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And when those twelve sheep had grown, they gave up one of them to the asses, and those asses again gave up that sheep to the wolves, and that sheep grew up among the wolves.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the Lord brought the eleven sheep to live with it and to pasture with it among the wolves: and they multiplied and became many flocks of sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the wolves began to fear them, and they oppressed them until they destroyed their little ones, and they cast their young into a river of much water: but those sheep began to cry aloud on account of their little ones, and to complain unto their Lord.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And a sheep which had been saved from the wolves fled and escaped to the wild asses; and I saw the sheep how they lamented and cried, and besought their Lord with all their might, till that Lord of the sheep descended at the voice of the sheep from a lofty abode, and came to them and pastured them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And He called that sheep which had escaped the wolves, and spake with it concerning the wolves that it should admonish them not to touch the sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the sheep went to the wolves according to the word of the Lord, and another sheep met it and went with it, and the two went and entered together into the assembly of those wolves, and spake with them and admonished them not to touch the sheep from henceforth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thereupon I saw the wolves, and how they oppressed the sheep exceedingly with all their power; and the sheep cried aloud.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the Lord came to the sheep and they began to smite those wolves: and the wolves began to make lamentation; but the sheep became quiet and forthwith ceased to cry out.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw the sheep till they departed from amongst the wolves; but the eyes of the wolves were blinded, and those wolves departed in pursuit of the sheep with all their power.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the Lord of the sheep went with them, as their leader, and all His sheep followed Him: and His face was dazzling and glorious and terrible to behold.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But the wolves began to pursue those sheep till they reached a sea of water.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that sea was divided, and the water stood on this side and on that before their face, and their Lord led them and placed Himself between them and the wolves.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And as those wolves did not yet see the sheep, they proceeded into the midst of that sea, and the wolves followed the sheep, and [those wolves] ran after them into that sea.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And when they saw the Lord of the sheep, they turned to flee before His face, but that sea gathered itself together, and became as it had been created, and the water swelled and rose till it covered those wolves.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till all the wolves who pursued those sheep perished and were drowned.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 28-40. _Israel in the Desert, the Giving of the Law, the Entrance into Palestine._

title: 1 Enoch
text: But the sheep escaped from that water and went forth into a wilderness, where there was no water and no grass; and they began to open their eyes and to see; and I saw the Lord of the sheep pasturing them and giving them water and grass, and that sheep going and leading them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that sheep ascended to the summit of that lofty rock, and the Lord of the sheep sent it to them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that I saw the Lord of the sheep who stood before them, and His appearance was great and terrible and majestic, and all those sheep saw Him and were afraid before His face.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they all feared and trembled because of Him, and they cried to that sheep with them [which was amongst them]: “We are not able to stand before our Lord or to behold Him.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that sheep which led them again ascended to the summit of that rock, but the sheep began to be blinded and to wander from the way which he had showed them, but that sheep wot not thereof.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the Lord of the sheep was wrathful exceedingly against them, and that sheep discovered it, and went down from the summit of the rock, and came to the sheep, and found the greatest part of them blinded and fallen away.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And when they saw it they feared and trembled at its presence, and desired to return to their folds.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that sheep took other sheep with it, and came to those sheep which had fallen away, and began to slay them; and the sheep feared its presence, and thus that sheep brought back those sheep that had fallen away, and they returned to their folds.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw in this vision till that sheep became a man and built a house for the Lord of the sheep, and placed all the sheep in that house.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till this sheep which had met that sheep which led them fell asleep: and I saw till all the great sheep perished and little ones arose in their place, and they came to a pasture, and approached a stream of water.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then that sheep, their leader which had become a man, withdrew from them and fell asleep, and all the sheep sought it and cried over it with a great crying.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till they left off crying for that sheep and crossed that stream of water, and there arose the =two= sheep as leaders in the place of those which had led them and fallen asleep (lit. “had fallen asleep and led them”).

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till the sheep came to a goodly place, and a pleasant and glorious land, and I saw till those sheep were satisfied; and that house stood amongst them in the pleasant land.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 41-50. _From the Time of the Judges till the Building of the Temple._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And sometimes their eyes were opened, and sometimes blinded, till another sheep arose and led them and brought them all back, and their eyes were opened.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the dogs and the foxes and the wild boars began to devour those sheep till the Lord of the sheep raised up [another sheep] a ram from their midst, which led them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that ram began to butt on either side those dogs, foxes, and wild boars till he had destroyed them †all†.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that sheep whose eyes were opened saw that ram, which was amongst the sheep, =till= it †forsook its glory† and began to butt those sheep, and trampled upon them, and behaved itself unseemly.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the Lord of the sheep sent the =lamb= to another =lamb= and raised it to being a ram and leader of the sheep instead of that ram which had †forsaken its glory†.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And it went to it and spake to it alone, and raised it to being a ram, and made it the prince and leader of the sheep; but during all these things those dogs oppressed the sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the first ram pursued that second ram, and that second ram arose and fled before it; and I saw till those dogs pulled down the firsts ram.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that second ram arose and led the [little] sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And those sheep grew and multiplied; but all the dogs, and foxes, and wild boars feared and fled before it, and that ram butted and killed the wild beasts, and those wild beasts had no longer any power among the sheep and robbed them no more of aught. 48^b. And that ram begat many sheep and fell asleep; and a little sheep became ram in its stead, and became prince and leader of those sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that house became great and broad, and it was built for those sheep: ‹and› a tower lofty and great was built on the house for the Lord of the sheep, and that house was low, but the tower was elevated and lofty, and the Lord of the sheep stood on that tower and they offered a full table before Him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 51-67. _The Two Kingdoms of Israel and Judah, to the Destruction of Jerusalem._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And again I saw those sheep that they again erred and went many ways, and forsook that their house, and the Lord of the sheep called some from amongst the sheep and sent them to the sheep, but the sheep began to slay them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And one of them was saved and was not slain, and it sped away and cried aloud over the sheep; and they sought to slay it, but the Lord of the sheep saved it from the sheep, and brought it up to me, and caused it to dwell there.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And many other sheep He sent to those sheep to testify unto them and lament over them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of the Lord and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw the Lord of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And He gave them over into the hands of the lions and tigers, and wolves and hyenas, and into the hand of the foxes, and to all the wild beasts, and those wild beasts began to tear in pieces those sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw that He forsook that their house and their tower and gave them all into the hand of the lions, to tear and devour them, into the hand of all the wild beasts.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I began to cry aloud with all my power, and to appeal to the Lord of the sheep, and to represent to Him in regard to the sheep that they were devoured by all the wild beasts.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But He remained unmoved, though He saw it, and rejoiced that they were devoured and swallowed and robbed, and left them to be devoured in the hand of all the beasts.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And He called seventy shepherds, and cast those sheep to them that they might pasture them, and He spake to the shepherds and their companions: “Let each individual of you pasture the sheep henceforward, and everything that I shall command you that do ye.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I will deliver them over unto you duly numbered, and tell you which of them are to be destroyed—and them destroy ye.” And He gave over unto them those sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And He called another and spake unto him: “Observe and mark everything that the shepherds will do to those sheep; for they will destroy more of them than I have commanded them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And every excess and the destruction which will be wrought through the shepherds, record (namely) how many they destroy according to my command, and how many according to their own caprice: record against every individual shepherd all the destruction he effects.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And read out before me by number how many they destroy, and how many they deliver over for destruction, that I may have this as a testimony against them, and know every deed of the shepherds, that I may =comprehend= and see what they do, whether or not they abide by my command which I have commanded them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But they shall not know it, and thou shalt not declare it to them, nor admonish them, but only record against each individual all the destruction which the shepherds effect each in his time, and lay it all before me.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till those shepherds pastured in their season, and they began to slay and to destroy more than they were bidden, and they delivered those sheep into the hand of the lions.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the lions and tigers ate and devoured the greater part of those sheep, and the wild boars ate along with them; and they burnt that tower and demolished that house.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I became exceedingly sorrowful over that tower because that house of the sheep was demolished, and afterwards I was unable to see if those sheep entered that house.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 68-71. _First Period of the Angelic Rulers—from the Destruction of Jerusalem to the Return from the Captivity._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the shepherds and their associates delivered over those sheep to all the wild beasts, to devour them, and each one of them received in his time a definite number: it was written by the other in a book how many each one of them destroyed of them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And each one slew and destroyed many more than was prescribed; and I began to weep and lament on account of those sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thus in the vision I saw that one who wrote how he wrote down every one that was destroyed by those shepherds, day by day, and carried up and laid down and showed actually the whole book to the Lord of the sheep—(even) everything that they had done, and all that each one of them had made away with, and all that they had given over to destruction.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the book was read before the Lord of the sheep, and He took the book from his hand and read it and sealed it and laid it down.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 72-77. _Second Period—from the time of Cyrus to that of Alexander the Great._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And forthwith I saw how the shepherds pastured for twelve hours, and behold three of those sheep turned back and came and entered and began to build up all that had fallen down of that house; but the wild boars tried to hinder them, but they were not able.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they began again to build as before, and they reared up that tower, and it was named the high tower; and they began again to place a table before the tower, but all the bread on it was polluted and not pure.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And as touching all this the eyes of those sheep were blinded so that they saw not, and (the eyes of) their shepherds likewise; and they delivered them in large numbers to their shepherds for destruction, and they trampled the sheep with their feet and devoured them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the Lord of the sheep remained unmoved till all the sheep were dispersed over the field and mingled with them (_i. e._ the beasts), and they (_i. e._ the shepherds) did not save them out of the hand of the beasts.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And this one who wrote the book carried it up, and showed it and read it before the Lord of the sheep, and implored Him on their account, and besought Him on their account as he showed Him all the doings of the shepherds, and gave testimony before Him against all the shepherds.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he took the actual book and laid it down beside Him and departed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 1-5. _Third Period—from Alexander the Great to the Graeco-Syrian Domination._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till that in this manner =thirty-five= shepherds undertook the pasturing (of the sheep), and they severally completed their periods as did the first; and others received them into their hands to pasture them for their period, each shepherd in his own period.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that I saw in my vision all the birds of heaven coming, the eagles, the vultures, the kites, the ravens; but the eagles led all the birds; and they began to devour those sheep, and to pick out their eyes and to devour their flesh.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the sheep cried out because their flesh was being devoured by the birds, and as for me I looked and lamented in my sleep over that shepherd who pastured the sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw until those sheep were devoured by the dogs and eagles and kites, and they left neither flesh nor skin nor sinew remaining on them till only their bones stood there: and their bones too fell to the earth and the sheep became few.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw until that twenty-three had undertaken the pasturing and completed in their several periods fifty-eight times.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 6-12. _Fourth Period—from the Graeco-Syrian Domination to the Maccabæan Revolt._

title: 1 Enoch
text: But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Yea, they cried to them, but they did not hearken to what they said to them, but were exceedingly deaf, and their eyes were very exceedingly blinded.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw in the vision how the ravens flew upon those lambs, and took one of those lambs, and dashed the sheep in pieces and devoured them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till horns grew upon those lambs, and the ravens cast down their horns; and I saw till there sprouted a great horn of one of those sheep, and their eyes were opened.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And it †looked at† them [and their eyes opened], and it cried to the sheep, and the rams saw it and all ran to it.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And notwithstanding all this those eagles and vultures and ravens and kites still kept tearing the sheep and swooping down upon them and devouring them: still the sheep remained silent, but the rams lamented and cried out.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And those ravens fought and battled with it and sought to lay low its horn, but they had no power over it.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 13-19. _The last Assault of the Gentiles on the Jews_(where vv. 13-15 and 16-18 are doublets).

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till the †shepherds and† eagles and those vultures and kites came, and †they cried to the ravens† that they should break the horn of that ram, and they battled and fought with it, and it battled with them and cried that its help might come.

title: 1 Enoch
text: All the eagles and vultures and ravens and kites were gathered together, and there came with them all the sheep of the field, yea, they all came together, and helped each other to break that horn of the ram.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till a great sword was given to the sheep, and the sheep proceeded against all the beasts of the field to slay them, and all the beasts and the birds of the heaven fled before their face.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till that man, who wrote down the names of the shepherds [and] carried up into the presence of the Lord of the sheep [came and helped it and showed it everything: he had come down for the help of that ram].

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till the Lord of the sheep came unto them in wrath, and all who saw Him fled, and they all fell †into His shadow† from before His face.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw that man, who wrote the book according to the command of the Lord, till he opened that book concerning the destruction which those twelve last shepherds had wrought, and showed that they had destroyed much more than their predecessors, before the Lord of the sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till the Lord of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of his wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 20-27. _Judgement of the Fallen Angels, the Shepherds, and the Apostates._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till a throne was erected in the pleasant land, and the Lord of the sheep sat Himself thereon, and =the other= took the sealed books and opened those books before the Lord of the sheep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the Lord called those men the seven first white ones, and commanded that they should bring before Him, beginning with the first star which led the way, =all the= stars whose privy members were like those of horses, and they brought them all before Him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And He said to that man who wrote before Him, being one of those seven white ones, and said unto him: “Take those seventy shepherds to whom I delivered the sheep, and who taking them on their own authority slew more than I commanded them.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: And behold, they were all bound, I saw, and they all stood before Him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the judgement was held first over the stars, and they were judged and found guilty, and went to the place of condemnation, and they were cast into an abyss, full of fire and flaming, and full of pillars of fire.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw at that time how a like abyss was opened in the midst of the earth, full of fire, and they brought those blinded sheep, and they were all judged and found guilty and cast into this fiery abyss, and they burned; now this abyss was to the right of that house.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw those sheep burning †and their bones burning†.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 28-38. _The New Jerusalem, the Conversion of the surviving Gentiles, the Resurrection of the Righteous, the Messiah._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I stood up to see till they folded up that old house; and carried off all the pillars, and all the beams and ornaments of the house were at the same time folded up with it, and they carried it off and laid it in a place in the south of the land.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till the Lord of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw all the sheep which had been left, and all the beasts on the earth, and all the birds of the heaven, falling down and doing homage to those sheep and making petition to and obeying them in every =thing=.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thereafter those three who were clothed in white and had seized me by my hand [who had taken me up before], and the hand of that ram also seizing hold of me, they took me up and set me down in the midst of those sheep †before the judgement took place†.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And those sheep were all white, and their wool was abundant and clean.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till they laid down that sword, which had been given to the sheep, and they brought it back into the house, and it was sealed before the presence of the Lord, and all the sheep were invited into that house, but it held them not.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the eyes of them all were opened, and they saw the good, and there was not one among them that did not see.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw that that house was large and broad and very full.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw that a white bull was born, with large horns, and all the beasts of the field and all the birds of the air feared him and made petition to him all the time.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw till all their generations were transformed, and they all became white bulls; and the first among them became a =lamb=, and that =lamb= became a great animal and had great black horns on its head; and the Lord of the sheep rejoiced over =it= and over all the oxen.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I slept in their midst: and I awoke and saw everything.

title: 1 Enoch
text: This is the vision which I saw while I slept, and I awoke and blessed the Lord of righteousness and gave Him glory.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I wept with a great weeping, and my tears stayed not till I could no longer endure it: when I saw, they flowed on account of what I had seen; for everything shall come and be fulfilled; and all the deeds of men in their order were shown to me.

title: 1 Enoch
text: On that night I remembered the first dream, and because of it I wept and was troubled—because I had seen that vision.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: THE CONCLUDING SECTION OF THE BOOK. (XCII-CV.)

title: 1 Enoch
text: XCI. 1-10, 18-19. _Enoch’s Book of Admonition for his Children._

title: 1 Enoch
text: The book written by Enoch—[Enoch indeed wrote this complete doctrine of wisdom, (which is) praised of all men and a judge of all the earth] for all my children who shall dwell on the earth; and for the future generations who shall observe uprightness and peace.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Let not your spirit be troubled on account of the times; For the Holy and Great One has appointed days for all things.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the righteous one shall arise from sleep, [Shall arise] and walk in the paths of righteousness, And all his path and conversation shall be in eternal goodness and grace.

title: 1 Enoch
text: He will be gracious to the righteous and give him eternal uprightness, And He will give him power so that he shall be (endowed) with goodness and righteousness, And he shall walk in eternal light.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And sin shall perish in darkness for ever, And shall no more be seen from that day forevermore.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 1-11, 18-19. _Enoch’s Admonition to his Children._

title: 1 Enoch
text: ‘And now, my son Methuselah, call to me all thy brothers, And gather together to me all the sons of thy mother, For the word calls me, And the spirit is poured out upon me, That I may show you everything That shall befall you for ever.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thereupon Methuselah went and summoned to him all his brothers and assembled his relatives.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he spake unto all the children of righteousness and said:

title: 1 Enoch
text: ‘Hear, ye sons of Enoch, all the words of your father, And hearken aright to the voice of my mouth; For I exhort you and say unto you, beloved:

title: 1 Enoch
text: And draw not nigh to uprightness with a double heart, And associate not with those of a double heart, But walk in righteousness, my sons. And it shall guide you on good paths, And righteousness shall be your companion.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For I know that violence =must= increase on the earth, And a great chastisement be executed on the earth, And all unrighteousness come to an end:

title: 1 Enoch
text: Yea, it shall be cut off from its roots, And its whole structure be destroyed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And unrighteousness shall again be consummated on the earth, And all the deeds of unrighteousness and of violence And transgression shall prevail in a twofold degree.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And when sin and unrighteousness and blasphemy And violence in all kinds of deeds increase, And apostasy and transgression and uncleanness increase, A great chastisement shall come from heaven upon all these, And the holy Lord will come forth with wrath and chastisement To execute judgement on earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days violence shall be cut off from its roots, And the roots of unrighteousness together with deceit, And they shall be destroyed from under heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all the idols of the heathen shall be abandoned, And the temples burned with fire, And they shall remove them from the whole earth,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they (_i. e._ the heathen) shall be cast into the judgement of fire, And shall perish in wrath and in grievous judgement for ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the righteous shall arise from their sleep, And wisdom shall arise and be given unto them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: [11. And after that the roots of unrighteousness shall be cut off, and the sinners shall be destroyed by the sword ... shall be cut off from the blasphemers in every place, and those who plan violence and those who commit blasphemy shall perish by the sword.]

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now I tell you, my sons, and show you The paths of righteousness, and the paths of violence. Yea, I will show them to you again, That ye may know what will come to pass.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now, hearken unto me, my sons, And walk in the paths of righteousness, And walk not in the paths of violence; For all who walk in the paths of unrighteousness shall perish for =ever=.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: XCIII, XCI. 12-17. _The Apocalypse of Weeks._

title: 1 Enoch
text: 12-17. _The Last Three Weeks._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that there shall be another, the eighth week, that of righteousness, And a sword shall be given to it that a righteous judgement may be executed on the oppressors, And sinners shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And at its close they shall acquire houses through their righteousness, And a house shall be built for the Great King in glory for evermore, 14_d._ And all mankind shall look to the path of uprightness.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 14_a._ And after that, in the ninth week, the righteous judgement shall be revealed to the whole world, _b._ And all the works of the godless shall vanish from all the earth, _c._ And the world shall be written down for destruction.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after this, in the tenth week in the seventh part, There shall be the great eternal judgement, In which He will execute vengeance amongst the angels.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the first heaven shall depart and pass away, And a new heaven shall appear, And all the powers of the heavens shall give sevenfold light.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that there will be many weeks without number for ever, And all shall be in goodness and righteousness, And sin shall no more be mentioned for ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that Enoch both †gave† and began to recount from the books.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And Enoch said:

title: 1 Enoch
text: ‘Concerning the children of righteousness and concerning the elect of the world, And concerning the plant of uprightness, I will speak these things, Yea, I Enoch, will declare (them) unto you, my sons:

title: 1 Enoch
text: According to that which appeared to me in the heavenly vision, And which I have known through the word of the holy angels, And have learnt from the heavenly tablets.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And Enoch began to recount from the books and said: ‘I was born the seventh in the first week, While judgement and righteousness still endured.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after me there shall arise in the second week great wickedness, And deceit shall have sprung up; And in it there shall be the first end.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in it a man shall be saved; And after it is ended unrighteousness shall grow up, And a law shall be made for the sinners.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that in the third week at its close A man shall be elected as the plant of righteous judgement. And =his posterity= shall become the plant of righteousness for evermore.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that in the fourth week, at its close, Visions of the holy and righteous shall be seen, And a law for all generations and an enclosure shall be made for them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that in the fifth week, at its close, The house of glory and dominion shall be built for ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that in the sixth week all who live in it shall be blinded, And the hearts of all of them shall godlessly forsake wisdom.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in it a man shall ascend; And at its close the house of dominion shall be burnt with fire, And the whole race of the chosen root shall be dispersed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that in the seventh week shall an apostate generation arise, And many shall be its deeds, And all its deeds shall be apostate.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And at its close shall be elected The elect righteous of the eternal plant of righteousness, To receive sevenfold instruction concerning all His creation.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And how should there be one who could behold the heaven, and who is there that could understand the things of heaven and see a soul or a spirit and could tell thereof, or ascend and see all their ends and think them or do like them?

title: 1 Enoch
text: And who is there of all men that could know what is the breadth and the length of the earth, and to whom has been shown the measure of all of them?

title: 1 Enoch
text: Or is there any one who could discern the length of the heaven and how great is its height, and upon what it is founded, and how great is the number of the stars, and where all the luminaries rest?]

title: 1 Enoch
text: 1-5. _Admonitions to the Righteous._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptation, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves afar from them, And shall not follow them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now I say unto you the righteous: Walk not in the paths of wickedness, nor on the paths of death, And draw not nigh to them, lest ye be destroyed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But seek and choose for yourselves righteousness and an elect life, And walk in the paths of peace, And ye shall live and prosper.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And hold fast my words in the thoughts of your hearts, And suffer them not to be effaced from your hearts;

title: 1 Enoch
text: For know that sinners will tempt men to =evilly-entreat= wisdom, So that no place may be found for her, And no manner of temptation may minish.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 6-11. _Woes for the Sinners._

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to those who build unrighteousness and oppression, And lay deceit as a foundation; For they shall be suddenly overthrown, And they shall have no peace.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to those who build their houses with sin; For from all their foundations shall they be overthrown, And by the sword shall they fall.

title: 1 Enoch
text: [And those who acquire gold and silver in judgement suddenly shall perish.]

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the Most High in the days of your riches.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Ye have committed blasphemy and unrighteousness, And have become ready for the day of slaughter, And the day of darkness and the day of the great judgement.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Thus I speak and declare unto you: He who hath created you will overthrow you, And for your fall there shall be no compassion, And your Creator will rejoice at your destruction.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And your righteous ones in those days shall be A reproach to the sinners and the godless.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Enoch’s Grief: fresh Woes against the Sinners._

title: 1 Enoch
text: Oh that mine eyes were [a cloud of] waters That I might weep over you, And pour down my tears as a cloud †of† waters: That so I might rest from my trouble of heart!

title: 1 Enoch
text: †Who has permitted you to practise reproaches and wickedness? And so judgement shall overtake you, sinners.†

title: 1 Enoch
text: Fear not the sinners, ye righteous; For again will the Lord deliver them into your hands, That ye may execute judgement upon them according to your desires.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who fulminate anathemas which cannot be reversed: Healing shall therefore be far from you because of your sins.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who requite your neighbour with evil; For ye shall be requited according to your works.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, lying witnesses, And to those who weigh out injustice, For suddenly shall ye perish.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Grounds of Hopefulness for the Righteous: Woes for the Wicked._

title: 1 Enoch
text: Be hopeful, ye righteous; for suddenly shall the sinners perish before you, And ye shall have lordship over them according to your desires.

title: 1 Enoch
text: [2. And in the day of the tribulation of the sinners, Your children shall mount and rise as eagles, And higher than the vultures will be your nest,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And ye shall ascend and enter the crevices of the earth, And the clefts of the rock for ever as coneys before the unrighteous, And the sirens shall sigh because of you and weep.]

title: 1 Enoch
text: Wherefore fear not, ye that have suffered; For healing shall be your portion, And a bright light shall enlighten you, And the voice of rest ye shall hear from heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe unto you, ye sinners, for your riches make you appear like the righteous, But your hearts convict you of being sinners, And this fact shall be a testimony against you for a memorial of (your) evil deeds.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink =wine in large bowls=, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who drink water =from every fountain=, For suddenly shall ye be consumed and wither away, Because ye have forsaken the fountain of life.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who work unrighteousness, And deceit and blasphemy: It shall be a memorial against you for evil.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Evils in Store for Sinners and the Possessors of unrighteous Wealth._

title: 1 Enoch
text: Believe, ye righteous, that the sinners will become a shame, And perish in the day of unrighteousness.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Be it known unto you (ye sinners) that the Most High is mindful of your destruction, And the angels of heaven rejoice over your destruction.

title: 1 Enoch
text: What will ye do, ye sinners, And whither will ye flee on that day of judgement, When ye hear the voice of the prayer of the righteous?

title: 1 Enoch
text: Yea, ye shall fare like unto them, Against whom this word shall be a testimony: “Ye have been companions of sinners.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in those days the prayer of the righteous shall reach unto the Lord. And for you the days of your judgement shall come,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all the words of your unrighteousness shall be read out before the Great Holy One; And your faces shall be covered with shame, And He will reject every work which is grounded on unrighteousness.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid-ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who acquire silver and gold in unrighteousness, and say: “We have become rich with riches and have possessions, And have acquired everything we have desired.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, 9^d And many are the husbandmen in our houses, 9^c And our granaries are (brim)full as with water.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: Yea, and like water your lies shall flow away; For your riches shall not abide, But speedily ascend from you;

title: 1 Enoch
text: For ye have acquired it all in unrighteousness, And ye shall be given over to a great curse.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Self-indulgence of Sinners: Sin originated by Man: all Sin recorded in Heaven: Woes for the Sinners._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now I swear unto you, to the wise and to the foolish, For ye shall have manifold experiences on the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For ye men shall put on more adornments than a woman, And coloured garments more than a virgin: In royalty and in grandeur and in power, And in silver and in gold and in purple, And in splendour and in food they shall be poured out as water.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Therefore they shall be wanting in doctrine and wisdom, And they shall perish thereby together with their possessions; And with all their glory and their splendour, And in shame and in slaughter and in great destitution, Their spirits shall be cast into the furnace of fire.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I have sworn unto you, ye sinners, as a mountain has not become a slave, And a hill does not become the handmaid of a woman, Even so sin has not been sent upon the earth, But man of himself has created it, And under a great curse shall they fall who commit it.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And barrenness has not been given to the woman, But on account of the deeds of her own hands she dies without children.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I have sworn unto you, ye sinners, by the Holy Great One, That all your evil deeds are revealed in the heavens, And that none of your deeds of oppression are covered and hidden.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And do not think in your spirit, nor say in your heart, that ye do not know and that ye do not see that every sin is every day recorded in heaven in the presence of the Most High.

title: 1 Enoch
text: From henceforth ye know that all your oppression wherewith ye oppress is written down every day till the day of your judgement.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, ye fools, for through your folly shall ye perish: and ye transgress against the wise, and so good hap shall not be your portion.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, ye obstinate of heart, who work wickedness and eat blood: Whence have ye good things to eat and to drink and to be filled?

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who love the deeds of unrighteousness: wherefore do ye hope for good hap unto yourselves? know that ye shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous, and they shall cut off your necks and slay you, and have no mercy upon you.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who rejoice in the tribulation of the righteous; for no grave shall be dug for you.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who set at nought the words of the righteous; for ye shall have no hope of life.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who write down lying and godless words; for they write down their lies that men may hear them and act godlessly towards (their) neighbour.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Therefore they shall have no peace, but die a sudden death.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Woes pronounced on the Godless, the Lawbreakers: evil Plight of Sinners in the last Days: further Woes._

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who work godlessness, And glory in lying, and extol them: Ye shall perish, and no happy life shall be yours.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days make ready, ye righteous, to raise your prayers as =a= memorial, And place them as a testimony before the angels, That they may place the sin of the sinners for a memorial before the Most High.

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days the nations shall be stirred up, And the families of the nations shall arise on the day of destruction.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them, And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And again I swear to you, ye sinners, that sin is prepared for a day of unceasing bloodshed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood ‹and stone› and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they shall become godless by reason of the folly of their hearts, And their eyes shall be blinded through the fear of their hearts, And through visions in their dreams.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Through these they shall become godless and fearful; For they shall have wrought all their work in a lie, And shall have worshipped a stone: Therefore in an instant shall they perish.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But in those days blessed are all they who accept the words of wisdom, and understand them, And observe the paths of the Most High, and walk in the path of His righteousness, And become not godless with the godless; For they shall be saved.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who spread evil to your neighbours; For you shall be slain in Sheol.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who make deceitful and false measures, And (to them) who cause bitterness on the earth; For they shall thereby be utterly consumed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you who build your houses through the grievous toil of others, And all their building materials are the bricks and stones of sin; I tell you ye shall have no peace.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to them who reject the measure and eternal heritage of their fathers, And whose souls follow after idols; For they shall have no rest.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to them who work unrighteousness and help oppression, And slay their neighbours until the day of the great judgement.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For He shall cast down your glory, And bring affliction on your hearts, And shall arouse =His fierce indignation=, And destroy you all with the sword; And all the holy and righteous shall remember your sins.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Sinners destroy each other: Judgement of the fallen Angels: the Safety of the Righteous: further Woes for the Sinners._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten, And brothers one with another shall fall in death, Till the streams flow with their blood.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For a man shall not withhold his hand from slaying his sons and his son’s sons, And the sinner shall not withhold his hand from his honoured brother: From dawn till sunset they shall slay one another.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the horse shall walk up to the breast in the blood of sinners, And the chariot shall be submerged to its height.

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days the angels shall descend into the secret places, And gather together into one place all those who brought down sin, And the Most High will arise on that day of Judgement, To execute great judgement amongst sinners.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And over all the righteous and holy He will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels, To guard them as the apple of an eye, Until He makes an end of all wickedness and all sin, And though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise =in security=, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, sinners, on the day of strong anguish, =Ye who= afflict the righteous and burn them with fire: Ye shall be requited according to your works.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, ye obstinate of heart, Who watch in order to devise wickedness: Therefore shall fear come upon you, And there shall be none to help you.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, ye sinners, on account of the words of your mouth, And on account of the deeds of your hands which your godlessness has wrought, In blazing flames burning worse than fire shall ye burn.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now, know ye that from the angels He will inquire as to your deeds in heaven, from the sun and from the moon and from the stars in reference to your sins because upon the earth ye execute judgement on the righteous.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And He will summon to testify against you every cloud and mist and dew and rain; for they shall all be withheld because of you from descending upon you, and they shall be mindful of your sins.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now give presents to the rain that it be not withheld from descending upon you, nor yet the dew, when it has received gold and silver from you that it may descend.

title: 1 Enoch
text: When the hoar-frost and snow with their chilliness, and all the snow-storms with all their plagues fall upon you, in those days ye shall not be able to stand before them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Exhortation to the Fear of God: all Nature fears Him, but not the Sinners._

title: 1 Enoch
text: Observe the heaven, ye children of heaven, and every work of the Most High, and fear ye Him and work no evil in His presence.

title: 1 Enoch
text: If He closes the windows of heaven, and withholds the rain and the dew from descending on the earth on your account, what will ye do then?

title: 1 Enoch
text: And if He sends His anger upon you because of your deeds, ye cannot petition Him; for ye spake proud and insolent words against His righteousness: therefore ye shall have no peace.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And see ye not the =sailors= of the ships, how their ships are tossed to and fro by the waves, and are shaken by the winds, and are in sore trouble?

title: 1 Enoch
text: And therefore do they fear because all their goodly possessions go upon the sea with them, and they have evil forebodings of heart that the sea will swallow them and they will perish therein.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Are not the entire sea and all its waters, and all its movements, the work of the Most High, and has He not set limits to its doings, and confined it throughout by the sand?

title: 1 Enoch
text: And at His reproof it is afraid and dries up, and all its fish die and all that is in it; but ye sinners that are on the earth fear Him not.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Has He not made the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein? Who has given understanding and wisdom to everything that moves on the earth and in the sea?

title: 1 Enoch
text: Do not the =sailors= of the ships fear the sea? Yet sinners fear not the Most High.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Terrors of the Day of Judgement: the adverse Fortunes of the Righteous on the Earth._

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days when He hath brought a grievous fire upon you, Whither will ye flee, and where will ye find deliverance? And when He launches forth His word against you, Will you not be affrighted and fear?

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all the luminaries shall be affrighted with great fear, And all the earth shall be affrighted and tremble and be alarmed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all the †angels shall execute their commands† And shall seek to hide themselves from the presence of the Great Glory, And the children of earth shall tremble and quake; And ye sinners shall be accursed for ever, And ye shall have no peace.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Fear ye not, ye souls of the righteous, And be hopeful ye that have died in righteousness.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And grieve not if your soul into Sheol has descended in grief, And that in your life your body fared not according to your goodness, But =wait for= the day of the =judgement= of sinners, And for the day of cursing and chastisement.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And yet when ye die the sinners speak over you: “As we die, so die the righteous, And what benefit do they reap for their deeds?

title: 1 Enoch
text: Behold, even as we, so do they die in grief and darkness, And what have they more than we? From henceforth we are equal.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And what will they receive and what will they see for ever? Behold, they too have died, And henceforth for ever shall they see no light.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: I tell you, ye sinners, ye are content to eat and drink, and rob and sin, and strip men naked, and acquire wealth and see good days.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Have ye seen the righteous how their end falls out, that no manner of violence is found in them till their death?

title: 1 Enoch
text: “Nevertheless they perished and became as though they had not been, and their spirits descended into Sheol in tribulation.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Different Destinies of the Righteous and the Sinners: fresh Objections of the Sinners._

title: 1 Enoch
text: Now, therefore, I swear to you, the righteous, by the glory of the Great and Honoured and Mighty One in dominion, and by His greatness I swear to you:

title: 1 Enoch
text: I know a mystery And have read the heavenly tablets, And have seen the holy books, And have found written therein and inscribed regarding them:

title: 1 Enoch
text: That all goodness and joy and glory are prepared for them, And written down for the spirits of those who have died in righteousness,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And that manifold good shall be given to you in recompense for your labours, And that your lot is abundantly beyond the lot of the living.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Woe to you, ye sinners, when ye have died, If ye die in the wealth of your sins; And those who are like you say regarding you:

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now they have died in prosperity and in wealth, And have not seen tribulation or murder in their life; And they have died in honour, And judgement has not been executed on them during their life.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: Know ye, that their souls will be made to descend into Sheol, And they shall be wretched in their great tribulation.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And into darkness and chains and a burning flame where there is grievous judgement shall your spirits enter; And the great judgement shall be for all the generations of the world. Woe to you, for ye shall have no peace.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Say not in regard to the righteous and good who are in life: “In our troubled days we have toiled laboriously and experienced every trouble, And met with much evil and been consumed, And have become few and our spirit small.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And we have been destroyed and have not found any to help us even with a word: We have been tortured [and destroyed], and hoped not to see life from day to day.

title: 1 Enoch
text: We hoped to be the head and have become the tail: We have toiled laboriously and had no satisfaction in our toil; And we have become the food of the sinners and the unrighteous, And they have laid their yoke heavily upon us.

title: 1 Enoch
text: They have had dominion over us that hated us †and smote us; And to those that hated us† we have bowed our necks, But they pitied us not.

title: 1 Enoch
text: We desired to get away from them that we might escape and be at rest, But found no place whereunto we should flee and be safe from them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And we complained to the rulers in our tribulation, And cried out against those who devoured us; But they did not attend to our cries, And would not hearken to our voice.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they helped those who robbed us and devoured us and those who made us few; and they concealed their oppression, and they did not remove from us the yoke of those that devoured us and dispersed us and murdered us, and they concealed their murder, and remembered not that they had lifted up their hands against us.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Assurances given to the Righteous: Admonitions to Sinners and the Falsifiers of the Words of Uprightness._

title: 1 Enoch
text: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in your cry, cry for judgement, and it shall appear to you; for all your tribulation shall be visited on the rulers, and on all who helped those who plundered you.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Be hopeful, and cast not away your hope; for ye shall have great joy as the angels of heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: What shall ye be obliged to do? Ye shall not have to hide on the day of the great judgement and ye shall not be found as sinners, and the eternal judgement shall be far from you for all the generations of the world.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now fear not, ye righteous, when ye see the sinners growing strong and prospering in their ways: be not companions with them, but keep afar from their violence; for ye shall become companions of the hosts of heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And, although ye sinners say: “All our sins shall not be searched out and written down,” nevertheless they shall write down all your sins every day.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now I show unto you that light and darkness, day and night, see all your sins.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness, but in great sin.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But when they write down truthfully all my words in their languages, and do not change or minish aught from my words, but write them all down truthfully—all that I first testified concerning them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then, I know another mystery, that books shall be given to the righteous and the wise to become a cause of joy and uprightness and much wisdom.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And to them shall the books be given, and they shall believe in them and rejoice over them, and then shall all the righteous who have learnt therefrom all the paths of uprightness be recompensed.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: _God and the Messiah to dwell with Man._

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days the Lord bade (them) to summon and testify to the children of earth concerning their wisdom: Show (it) unto them; for ye are their guides, and a recompense over the whole earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For I and My Son will be united with them for ever in the paths of uprightness in their lives; and ye shall have peace: rejoice, ye children of uprightness. Amen.

title: 1 Enoch
text: FRAGMENT OF THE BOOK OF NOAH. (CVI-CVII.)

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after some days my son Methuselah took a wife for his son Lamech, and she became pregnant by him and bore a son.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And his body was white as snow and red as the blooming of a rose, and the hair of his head †and his long locks were white as wool, and his eyes beautiful†. And when he opened his eyes, he lighted up the whole house like the sun, and the whole house was very bright.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thereupon he arose in the hands of the midwife, opened his mouth, and †conversed with† the Lord of righteousness.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And his father Lamech was afraid of him and fled, and came to his father Methuselah.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he said unto him: ‘I have begotten a strange son, diverse from and unlike man, and resembling the sons of the God of heaven; and his nature is different, and he is not like us, and his eyes are as the rays of the sun, and his countenance is glorious.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And it seems to me that he is not sprung from me but from the angels, and I fear that in his days a wonder may be wrought on the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now, my father, I am here to petition thee and implore thee that thou mayest go to Enoch, our father, and learn from him the truth, for his dwelling-place is amongst the angels.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And when Methuselah heard the words of his son, he came to me to the ends of the earth; for he had heard that I was there, and he cried aloud, and I heard his voice and I came to him. And I said unto him: ‘Behold, here am I, my son, =wherefore= hast thou come to me?’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he answered and said: ‘Because of a great cause of anxiety have I come to thee, and because of a disturbing vision have I approached.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now, my father, hear me: unto Lamech my son there hath been born a son, the like of whom there is none, and his nature is not like man’s nature, and the colour of his body is whiter than snow and redder than the bloom of a rose, and the hair of his head is whiter than white wool, and his eyes are like the rays of the sun, and he opened his eyes and thereupon lighted up the whole house.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he arose in the hands of the midwife, and opened his mouth and blessed the Lord of heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And his father Lamech became afraid and fled to me, and did not believe that he was sprung from him, but that he was in the likeness of the angels of heaven; and behold I have come to thee that thou mayest make known to me the truth.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I, Enoch, answered and said unto him: ‘The Lord will do a new thing on the earth, and this I have already seen in a vision, and make known to thee that in the generation of my father Jared some of the =angels= of heaven transgressed the word of the Lord.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And behold they commit sin and transgress the law, and have united themselves with women and commit sin with them, and have married some of them, and have begotten children by them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they shall produce on the earth giants not according to the spirit, but according to the flesh, and there shall be a great punishment on the earth, and the earth shall be cleansed from all impurity.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Yea, there shall come a great destruction over the whole earth, and there shall be a deluge and a great destruction for one year.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And this son who has been born unto you shall be left on the earth, and his three children shall be saved with him: when all mankind that are on the earth shall die [he and his sons shall be saved].

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now make known to thy son Lamech that he who has been born is in truth his son, and call his name Noah; for he shall be left to you, and he and his sons shall be saved from the destruction, which shall come upon the earth on account of all the sin and all the unrighteousness, which shall be consummated on the earth in his days.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that there shall be still more unrighteousness than that which was first consummated on the earth; for I know the mysteries of the holy ones; for He, the Lord, has showed me and informed me, and I have read (them) in the heavenly tablets.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw written on them that generation upon generation shall transgress, till a generation of righteousness arises, and transgression is destroyed and sin passes away from the earth, and all manner of good comes upon it.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now, my son, go and make known to thy son Lamech that this son, which has been born, is in truth his son, and that (this) is no lie.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And when Methuselah had heard the words of his father Enoch—for he had shown to him everything in secret—he returned and showed (them) to him and called the name of that son Noah; for he will comfort the earth after all the destruction.

title: 1 Enoch
text: AN APPENDIX TO THE BOOK OF ENOCH.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Another book which Enoch wrote for his son Methuselah and for those who will come after him, and keep the law in the last days.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Ye who have done good shall wait for those days till an end is made of those who work evil, and an end of the might of the transgressors.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And wait ye indeed till sin has passed away, for their names shall be blotted out of the book of life and out of the holy books, and their seed shall be destroyed for ever, and their spirits shall be slain, and they shall cry and make lamentation in a place that is a chaotic wilderness, and =in the fire shall they burn=; for there is no earth there.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw there something like an invisible cloud; for by reason of its depth I could not †look over†, and I saw a flame of fire blazing brightly, and things like shining mountains circling and sweeping to and fro.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I asked one of the holy angels who was with me and said unto him: ‘What is this shining thing? for it is not a heaven, but only the flame of a blazing fire, and the voice of weeping and crying and lamentation and strong pain.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he said unto me: ‘This place which thou seest—here are cast the spirits of sinners and blasphemers, and of those who work wickedness, and of those who pervert every thing that the Lord hath spoken through the mouth of the prophets—(even) the things that shall be.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For some of them are written and inscribed above in the heaven, in order that the angels may read them and know that which shall befall the sinners, and the spirits of the humble, and of those who have afflicted their bodies, and been recompensed by God; and of those who have been put to shame by wicked men:

title: 1 Enoch
text: Who love God and loved neither gold nor silver nor any of the good things which are in the world, but gave over their bodies to torture.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Who, since they came into being, longed not after earthly food, but regarded everything as a passing breath, and lived accordingly, and the Lord tried them much, and their spirits were found pure so that they should bless His name.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all the blessings destined for them I have recounted in the books. And He hath assigned them their recompense, because they have been found to be such as loved heaven more than their life in the world, and though they were trodden under foot of wicked men, and experienced abuse and reviling from them and were put to shame, yet they blessed Me.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now I will summon the spirits of the good who belong to the generation of light, and I will transform those who were born in darkness, who in the flesh were not recompensed with such honour as their faithfulness deserved.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I will bring forth in shining light those who have loved My holy name, and I will seat each on the throne of his honour.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they shall be resplendent for times without number; for righteousness is the judgement of God; for to the faithful He will give faithfulness in the habitation of upright paths.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they shall see those who were born in darkness led into darkness, while the righteous shall be resplendent.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the sinners shall cry aloud and see them resplendent, and they indeed shall go where days and seasons are prescribed for them.’

title: 1 Enoc
text: Las palabras de la bendición de Enoc, con las cuales bendijo a los elegidos 〚and〛 justos, que vivirán en el día de la tribulación, cuando todos los impíos 〚y sin dios sean quitados.

title: 1 Enoc
text: Y él tomó su parábola y dijo: Enoc un hombre justo, cuyos ojos fueron abiertos por Dios, vio la visión del Santo en los cielos, que los ángeles me mostraron, y de ellos oí todo, y de ellos entendí como yo vi, pero no para esta generación, sino para un remoto que está por venir.

title: 1 Enoc
text: En cuanto a los elegidos dije, y tomé mi parábola sobre ellos:

title: 1 Enoc
text: El Santo Grande saldrá de Su morada,

title: 1 Enoc
text: Y el Dios eterno pisará sobre la tierra, (incluso) en el Monte Sinaí, [Y aparecerá de su campamento] Y aparecen en la fuerza de Su poder del cielo.

title: 1 Enoc
text: Y todos serán golpeados con temor, Y los vigilantes temblarán, Y grandes temores y temblores los tomarán hasta los confines de la tierra.

title: 1 Enoc
text: Y los montes altos seran sacudidos, Y los altos seran bajos, Y seran derribados como cera delante de la llama

title: 1 Enoc
text: Y la tierra será enteramente alquilada en la tierra, Y todo lo que está sobre la tierra perecerá, Y habrá juicio sobre todos (hombres).

title: 1 Enoc
text: Pero con los justos Él hará la paz, Y protegerá a los elegidos, Y la misericordia será sobre ellos.

title: 1 Enoc
text: Y todos ellos pertenecen a Dios, Y serán prosperados, Y serán bendecidos.

title: 1 Enoc
text: Y Él les ayudará a todos. Y la luz les aparecerá, Y hará paz con ellos.

title: 1 Enoc
text: ¡Y mira! Viene con diez miles de santos Para ejecutar el juicio sobre todos, Y para destruir a los impíos:

title: 1 Enoc
text: Y para condenar toda carne De todas las obras ⌜ de su ingodliness⌝ que han cometido impíamente, AndY de todas las cosas difíciles que ⌜ impíos pecadores ⌜ han hablado contra Él.

title: 1 Enoc
text: Observad todas las cosas que tienen lugar en el cielo, cómo no cambian sus órbitas, ⌜and⌝ las luminarias que están en el cielo, cómo todos ellos se levantan y ordenan cada uno en su tiempo, y no transgreden contra su orden establecido.

title: 1 Enoc
text: Mirad la tierra, y prestad atención a las cosas que tienen lugar sobre ella de primera a última, ⌜how =steadfast= que son⌝, cómo ⌜none de las cosas sobre la tierra ⌝ cambio, pero todas las obras de Dios aparecen ⌜ a vosotros.

title: 1 Enoc
text: He aquí el verano y el invierno, cómo toda la tierra está llena de agua, y las nubes y el rocío y la lluvia mienten sobre ella.

title: 1 Enoc
text: Observe y vea cómo (en el invierno) todos los árboles 〚seem〛 como si hubieran marchitado y derramado todas sus hojas, excepto catorce árboles, que no pierden su follaje pero conservan el viejo follaje de dos a tres años hasta que el nuevo venga.

title: 1 Enoc
