text: And the Lord said to his servants tempting them: Let Enoch stand before my face into eternity, and the glorious ones bowed down to the Lord, and said: Let Enoch go according to Your word.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And the Lord said to Michael: Go and take Enoch from out (of) his earthly garments, and anoint him with my sweet ointment, and put him into the garments of My glory.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And Michael did thus, as the Lord told him. He anointed me, and dressed me, and the appearance of that ointment is more than the great light, and his ointment is like sweet dew, and its smell mild, shining like the sun’s ray, and I looked at myself, and (I) was like (transfigured) one of his glorious ones.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And the Lord summoned one of his archangels by name Pravuil, whose knowledge was quicker in wisdom than the other archangels, who wrote all the deeds of the Lord; and the Lord said to Pravuil: Bring out the books from my store-houses, and a reed of quick-writing, and give (it) to Enoch, and deliver to him the choice and comforting books out of your hand.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And he was telling me all the works of heaven, earth and sea, and all the elements, their passages and goings, and the thunderings of the thunders, the sun and moon, the goings and changes of the stars, the seasons, years, days, and hours, the risings of the wind, the numbers of the angels, and the formation of their songs, and all human things, the tongue of every human song and life, the commandments, instructions, and sweet-voiced singings, and all things that it is fitting to learn.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And Pravuil told me: All the things that I have told you, we have written. Sit and write all the souls of mankind, however many of them are born, and the places prepared for them to eternity; for all souls are prepared to eternity, before the formation of the world.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And all double thirty days and thirty nights, and I wrote out all things exactly, and wrote three hundred and sixty-six books.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And the Lord summoned me, and said to me: Enoch, sit down on my left with Gabriel.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I bowed down to the Lord, and the Lord spoke to me: Enoch, beloved, all (that) you see, all things that are standing finished I tell to you even before the very beginning, all that I created from non-being, and visible (physical) things from invisible (spiritual).

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Hear, Enoch, and take in these my words, for not to My angels have I told my secret, and I have not told them their rise, nor my endless realm, nor have they understood my creating, which I tell you to-day.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For before all things were visible (physical), I alone used to go about in the invisible (spiritual) things, like the sun from east to west, and from west to east.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: But even the sun has peace in itself, while I found no peace, because I was creating all things, and I conceived the thought of placing foundations, and of creating visible (physical) creation.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I commanded in the very lowest (parts), that visible (physical) things should come down from invisible (spiritual), and Adoil came down very great, and I beheld him, and lo! He had a belly of great light.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I said to him: Become undone, Adoil, and let the visible (physical) (come) out of you.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And he came undone, and a great light came out. And I (was) in the midst of the great light, and as there is born light from light, there came forth a great age, and showed all creation, which I had thought to create.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I saw that (it was) good.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I placed for myself a throne, and took my seat on it, and said to the light: Go thence up higher and fix yourself high above the throne, and be A foundation to the highest things.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And above the light there is nothing else, and then I bent up and looked up from my throne.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I summoned the very lowest a second time, and said: Let Archas come forth hard, and he came forth hard from the invisible (spiritual).

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And Archas came forth, hard, heavy, and very red.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I said: Be opened, Archas, and let there be born from you, and he came undone, an age came forth, very great and very dark, bearing the creation of all lower things, and I saw that (it was) good and said to him:

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Go thence down below, and make yourself firm, and be a foundation for the lower things, and it happened and he went down and fixed himself, and became the foundation for the lower things, and below the darkness there is nothing else.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I commanded that there should be taken from light and darkness, and I said: Be thick, and it became thus, and I spread it out with the light, and it became water, and I spread it out over the darkness, below the light, and then I made firm the waters, that is to say the bottomless, and I made foundation of light around the water, and created seven circles from inside, and imaged (the water) like crystal wet and dry, that is to say like glass, (and) the circumcession of the waters and the other elements, and I showed each one of them its road, and the seven stars each one of them in its heaven, that they go thus, and I saw that it was good.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I separated between light and between darkness, that is to say in the midst of the water hither and thither, and I said to the light, that it should be the day, and to the darkness, that it should be the night, and there was evening and there was morning the first day.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And then I made firm the heavenly circle, and (made) that the lower water which is under heaven collect itself together, into one whole, and that the chaos become dry, and it became so.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Out of the waves I created rock hard and big, and from the rock I piled up the dry, and the dry I called earth, and the midst of the earth I called abyss, that is to say the bottomless, I collected the sea in one place and bound it together with a yoke.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I said to the sea: Behold I give you (your) eternal limits, and you shalt not break loose from your component parts.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Thus I made fast the firmament. This day I called me the first-created [Sunday].

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And for all the heavenly troops I imaged the image and essence of fire, and my eye looked at the very hard, firm rock, and from the gleam of my eye the lightning received its wonderful nature, (which) is both fire in water and water in fire, and one does not put out the other, nor does the one dry up the other, therefore the lightning is brighter than the sun, softer than water and firmer than hard rock.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And from the rock I cut off a great fire, and from the fire I created the orders of the incorporeal ten troops of angels, and their weapons are fiery and their raiment a burning flame, and I commanded that each one should stand in his order.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And one from out the order of angels, having turned away with the order that was under him, conceived an impossible thought, to place his throne higher than the clouds above the earth, that he might become equal in rank to my power.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I threw him out from the height with his angels, and he was flying in the air continuously above the bottomless.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: On the third day I commanded the earth to make grow great and fruitful trees, and hills, and seed to sow, and I planted Paradise, and enclosed it, and placed as armed (guardians) flaming angels, and thus I created renewal.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Then came evening, and came morning the fourth day.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: [Wednesday]. On the fourth day I commanded that there should be great lights on the heavenly circles.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: On the first uppermost circle I placed the stars, Kruno, and on the second Aphrodit, on the third Aris, on the fifth Zoues, on the sixth Ermis, on the seventh lesser the moon, and adorned it with the lesser stars.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And on the lower I placed the sun for the illumination of day, and the moon and stars for the illumination of night.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: The sun that it should go according to each constellation, twelve, and I appointed the succession of the months and their names and lives, their thunderings, and their hour-markings, how they should succeed.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Then evening came and morning came the fifth day.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: [Thursday]. On the fifth day I commanded the sea, that it should bring forth fishes, and feathered birds of many varieties, and all animals creeping over the earth, going forth over the earth on four legs, and soaring in the air, male sex and female, and every soul breathing the spirit of life.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And there came evening, and there came morning the sixth day.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: [Friday]. On the sixth day I commanded my wisdom to create man from seven consistencies: one, his flesh from the earth; two, his blood from the dew; three, his eyes from the sun; four, his bones from stone; five, his intelligence from the swiftness of the angels and from cloud; six, his veins and his hair from the grass of the earth; seven, his soul from my breath and from the wind.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I gave him seven natures: to the flesh hearing, the eyes for sight, to the soul smell, the veins for touch, the blood for taste, the bones for endurance, to the intelligence sweetness [enjoyment].

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I conceived a cunning saying to say, I created man from invisible (spiritual) and from visible (physical) nature, of both are his death and life and image, he knows speech like some created thing, small in greatness and again great in smallness, and I placed him on earth, a second angel, honourable, great and glorious, and I appointed him as ruler to rule on earth and to have my wisdom, and there was none like him of earth of all my existing creatures.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I appointed him a name, from the four component parts, from east, from west, from south, from north, and I appointed for him four special stars, and I called his name Adam, and showed him the two ways, the light and the darkness, and I told him:

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: This is good, and that bad, that I should learn whether he has love towards me, or hatred, that it be clear which in his race love me.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For I have seen his nature, but he has not seen his own nature, therefore (through) not seeing he will sin worse, and I said After sin (what is there) but death?

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I put sleep into him and he fell asleep. And I took from him A rib, and created him a wife, that death should come to him by his wife, and I took his last word and called her name mother, that is to say, Eva (Eve).

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Adam has life on earth, and I created a garden in Eden in the east, that he should observe the testament and keep the command.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I made the heavens open to him, that he should see the angels singing the song of victory, and the gloomless light.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And he was continuously in paradise, and the devil understood that I wanted to create another world, because Adam was lord on earth, to rule and control it.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: The devil is the evil spirit of the lower places, as a fugitive he made Sotona from the heavens as his name was Satanail (Satan), thus he became different from the angels, (but his nature) did not change (his) intelligence as far as (his) understanding of righteous and sinful (things).

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And he understood his condemnation and the sin which he had sinned before, therefore he conceived thought against Adam, in such form he entered and seduced Eva (Eve), but did not touch Adam.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: But I cursed ignorance, but what I had blessed previously, those I did not curse, I cursed not man, nor the earth, nor other creatures, but man’s evil fruit, and his works.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I said to him: Earth you are, and into the earth whence I took you you shalt go, and I will not ruin you, but send you whence I took you.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Then I can again receive you at My second presence.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I blessed all my creatures visible (physical) and invisible (spiritual). And Adam was five and half hours in paradise.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I blessed the seventh day, which is the Sabbath, on which he rested from all his works.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I appointed the eighth day also, that the eighth day should be the first-created after my work, and that (the first seven) revolve in the form of the seventh thousand, and that at the beginning of the eighth thousand there should be a time of not-counting, endless, with neither years nor months nor weeks nor days nor hours.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And now, Enoch, all that I have told you, all that you have understood, all that you have seen of heavenly things, all that you have seen on earth, and all that I have written in books by my great wisdom, all these things I have devised and created from the uppermost foundation to the lower and to the end, and there is no counsellor nor inheritor to my creations.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I am self-eternal, not made with hands, and without change.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: My thought is my counsellor, my wisdom and my word are made, and my eyes observe all things how they stand here and tremble with terror.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: If I turn away my face, then all things will be destroyed.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And apply your mind, Enoch, and know him who is speaking to you, and take thence the books which you yourself have written.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I give you Samuil and Raguil, who led you up, and the books, and go down to earth, and tell your sons all that I have told you, and all that you have seen, from the lower heaven up to my throne, and all the troops.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For I created all forces, and there is none that resists me or that does not subject himself to me. For all subject themselves to my monarchy, and labour for my sole rule.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Give them the books of the handwriting, and they will read (them) and will know me for the creator of all things, and will understand how there is no other God but me.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And let them distribute the books of your handwriting–children to children, generation to generation, nations to nations.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I will give you, Enoch, my intercessor, the archistratege Michael, for the handwritings of your fathers Adam, Seth, Enos, Cainan, Mahaleleel, and Jared your father.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: They have rejected my commandments and my yoke, worthless seed has come up, not fearing God, and they would not bow down to me, but have begun to bow down to vain gods, and denied my unity, and have laden the whole earth with untruths, offences, abominable lecheries, namely one with another, and all manner of other unclean wickedness, which are disgusting to relate.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And therefore I will bring down a deluge upon the earth and will destroy all men, and the whole earth will crumble together into great darkness.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Behold from their seed shall arise another generation, much afterwards, but of them many will be very insatiate.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: He who raises that generation, (shall) reveal to them the books of your handwriting, of your fathers, (to them) to whom he must point out the guardianship of the world, to the faithful men and workers of my pleasure, who do not acknowledge my name in vain.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And they shall tell another generation, and those (others) having read shall be glorified thereafter, more than the first.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Now, Enoch, I give you the term of thirty days to spend in your house, and tell your sons and all your household, that all may hear from my face what is told them by you, that they may read and understand, how there is no other God but me.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And that they may always keep my commandments, and begin to read and take in the books of your handwriting.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And after thirty days I shall send my angel for you, and he will take you from earth and from your sons to me.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And the Lord called upon one of the older angels, terrible and menacing, and placed him by me, in appearance white as snow, and his hands like ice, having the appearance of great frost, and he froze my face, because I could not endure the terror of the Lord, just as it is not possible to endure A stove’s fire and the sun’s heat, and the frost of the air.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And the Lord said to me: Enoch, if your face be not frozen here, no man will be able to behold your face.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And the Lord said to those men who first led me up: Let Enoch go down on to earth with you, and await him till the determined day.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And they placed me by night on my bed.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And Mathusal (Methuselah) expecting my coming, keeping watch by day and by night at my bed, was filled with awe when he heard my coming, and I told him, Let all my household come together, that I tell them everything.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Oh my children, my beloved ones, hear the admonition of your father, as much as is according to the Lord’s will.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I have been let come to you to-day, and announce to you, not from my lips, but from the Lord’s lips, all that is and was and all that is now, and all that will be till judgment-day.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For the Lord has let me come to you, you hear therefore the words of my lips, of a man made big for you, but I am one who has seen the Lord’s face, like iron made to glow from fire it sends forth sparks and burns.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: You look now upon my eyes, (the eyes) of a man big with meaning for you, but I have seen the Lord’s eyes, shining like the sun’s rays and filling the eyes of man with awe.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: You see now, my children, the right hand of a man that helps you, but I have seen the Lord’s right hand filling heaven as he helped me.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: You see the compass of my work like your own, but I have seen the Lord’s limitless and perfect compass, which has no end.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: You hear the words of my lips, as I heard the words of the Lord, like great thunder incessantly with hurling of clouds.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And now, my children, hear the discourses of the father of the earth, how fearful and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of the earth, how much more terrible and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of heaven, the controller (judge) of quick and dead, and of the heavenly troops. Who can endure that endless pain?

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And now, my children, I know all things, for this (is) from the Lord’s lips, and this my eyes have seen, from beginning to end.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I know all things, and have written all things into books, the heavens and their end, and their plenitude, and all the armies and their marchings.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I have measured and described the stars, the great countless multitude (of them).

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: What man has seen their revolutions, and their entrances? For not even the angels see their number, while I have written all their names.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I measured the sun’s circle, and measured its rays, counted the hours, I wrote down too all things that go over the earth, I have written the things that are nourished, and all seed sown and unsown, which the earth produces and all plants, and every grass and every flower, and their sweet smells, and their names, and the dwelling-places of the clouds, and their composition, and their wings, and how they bear rain and raindrops.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I investigated all things, and wrote the road of the thunder and of the lightning, and they showed me the keys and their guardians, their rise, the way they go; it is let out (gently) in measure by a chain, lest by A heavy chain and violence it hurl down the angry clouds and destroy all things on earth.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I wrote the treasure-houses of the snow, and the store-houses of the cold and the frosty airs, and I observed their season’s key-holder, he fills the clouds with them, and does not exhaust the treasure-houses.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I wrote the resting-places of the winds and observed and saw how their key-holders bear weighing-scales and measures; first, they put them in (one) weighing-scale, then in the other the weights and let them out according to measure cunningly over the whole earth, lest by heavy breathing they make the earth to rock.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I measured out the whole earth, its mountains, and all hills, fields, trees, stones, rivers, all existing things I wrote down, the height from earth to the seventh heaven, and downwards to the very lowest hell, and the judgment-place, and the very great, open and weeping hell.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I saw how the prisoners are in pain, expecting the limitless judgment.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I wrote down all those being judged by the judge, and all their judgment (and sentences) and all their works.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I saw all forefathers from (all) time with Adam and Eva (Eve), and I sighed and broke into tears and said of the ruin of their dishonour:

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Woe is me for my infirmity and (for that) of my forefathers, and thought in my heart and said:

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed (is) the man who has not been born or who has been born and shall not sin before the Lord’s face, that he come not into this place, nor bring the yoke of this place.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I saw the key-holders and guards of the gates of hell standing, like great serpents, and their faces like extinguishing lamps, and their eyes of fire, their sharp teeth, and I saw all the Lord’s works, how they are right, while the works of man are some (good), and others bad, and in their works are known those who lie evilly.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I, my children, measured and wrote out every work and every measure and every righteous judgment.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: As (one) year is more honourable than another, so is (one) man more honourable than another, some for great possessions, some for wisdom of heart, some for particular intellect, some for cunning, one for silence of lip, another for cleanliness, one for strength, another for comeliness, one for youth, another for sharp wit, one for shape of body, another for sensibility, let it be heard everywhere, but there is none better than he who fears God, he shall be more glorious in time to come.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: The Lord with his hands having created man, in the likeness of his own face, the Lord made him small and great.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Whoever reviles the ruler’s face, and abhors the Lord’s face, has despised the Lord's face, and he who vents anger on any man without injury, the Lord’s great anger will cut him down, he who spits on the face of man reproachfully, will be cut down at the Lord’s great judgment.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed is the man who does not direct his heart with malice against any man, and helps the injured and condemned, and raises the broken down, and shall do charity to the needy, because on the day of the great judgment every weight, every measure and every makeweight (will be) as in the market, that is to say (they are) hung on scales and stand in the market, (and every one) shall learn his own measure, and according to his measure shall take his reward.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Whoever hastens to make offerings before the Lord’s face, the Lord for his part will hasten that offering by granting of his work.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: But whoever increases his lamp before the Lord’s face and make not true judgment, the Lord will (not) increase his treasure in the realm of the highest.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: When the Lord demands bread, or candles, or (the )flesh (of beasts), or any other sacrifice, then that is nothing; but God demands pure hearts, and with all that (only) tests the heart of man.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Hear, my people, and take in the words of my lips.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: If any one bring any gifts to an earthly ruler, and have disloyal thoughts in his heart, and the ruler know this, will he not be angry with him, and not refuse his gifts, and not give him over to judgment?

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Or (if) one man make himself appear good to another by deceit of tongue, but (have) evil in his heart, then will not (the other) understand the treachery of his heart, and himself be condemned, since his untruth was plain to all?

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And when the Lord shall send a great light, then there will be judgment for the just and the unjust, and there no one shall escape notice.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And now, my children, lay thought on your hearts, mark well the words of your father, which are all (come) to you from the Lord’s lips.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Take these books of your father’s handwriting and read them.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For the books are many, and in them you will learn all the Lord’s works, all that has been from the beginning of creation, and will be till the end of time.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And if you will observe my handwriting, you will not sin against the Lord; because there is no other except the Lord, neither in heaven, nor in earth, nor in the very lowest (places), nor in the (one) foundation.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: The Lord has placed the foundations in the unknown, and has spread forth heavens visible (physical) and invisible (spiritual); he fixed the earth on the waters, and created countless creatures, and who has counted the water and the foundation of the unfixed, or the dust of the earth, or the sand of the sea, or the drops of the rain, or the morning dew, or the wind’s breathings? Who has filled earth and sea, and the indissoluble winter?

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I cut the stars out of fire, and decorated heaven, and put it in their midst.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: That the sun go along the seven heavenly circles, which are the appointment of one hundred and eighty-two thrones, that it go down on a short day, and again one hundred and eighty-two, that it go down on a big day, and he has two thrones on which he rests, revolving hither and thither above the thrones of the months, from the seventeenth day of the month Tsivan it goes down to the month Thevan, from the seventeenth of Thevan it goes up.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And thus it goes close to the earth, then the earth is glad and makes grow its fruits, and when it goes away, then the earth is sad, and trees and all fruits have no florescence.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: All this he measured, with good measurement of hours, and fixed A measure by his wisdom, of the visible (physical) and the invisible (spiritual).

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: From the invisible (spiritual) he made all things visible (physical), himself being invisible (spiritual).

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Thus I make known to you, my children, and distribute the books to your children, into all your generations, and amongst the nations who shall have the sense to fear God, let them receive them, and may they come to love them more than any food or earthly sweets, and read them and apply themselves to them.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And those who understand not the Lord, who fear not God, who accept not, but reject, who do not receive the (books), a terrible judgment awaits these.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed is the man who shall bear their yoke and shall drag them along, for he shall be released on the day of the great judgment.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I swear to you, my children, but I swear not by any oath, neither by heaven nor by earth, nor by any other creature which God created.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: The Lord said: There is no oath in me, nor injustice, but truth.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: If there is no truth in men, let them swear by the words, Yea, yea, or else, Nay, nay.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And I swear to you, yea, yea, that there has been no man in his mother’s womb, (but that) already before, even to each one there is a place prepared for the repose of that soul, and a measure fixed how much it is intended that a man be tried in this world.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Yea, children, deceive not yourselves, for there has been previously prepared a place for every soul of man.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I have put every man’s work in writing and none born on earth can remain hidden nor his works remain concealed.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: I see all things.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Now therefore, my children, in patience and meekness spend the number of your days, that you inherit endless life.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Endure for the sake of the Lord every wound, every injury, every evil word and attack.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: If ill-requitals befall you, return (them) not either to neighbour or enemy, because the Lord will return (them) for you and be your avenger on the day of great judgment, that there be no avenging here among men.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Whoever of you spends gold or silver for his brother’s sake, he will receive ample treasure in the world to come.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Injure not widows nor orphans nor strangers, lest God’s wrath come upon you.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Stretch out your hands to the poor according to your strength.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Hide not your silver in the earth.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Help the faithful man in affliction, and affliction will not find you in the time of your trouble.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And every grievous and cruel yoke that come upon you bear all for the sake of the Lord, and thus you will find your reward in the day of judgment.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: It is good to go morning, midday, and evening into the Lord’s dwelling, for the glory of your creator.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Because every breathing (thing) glorifies him, and every creature visible (physical) and invisible (spiritual) returns him praise.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed is the man who opens his lips in praise of God of Sabaoth and praises the Lord with his heart.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Cursed every man who opens his lips for the bringing into contempt and calumny of his neighbour, because he brings God into contempt.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed is he who opens his lips blessing and praising God.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Cursed is he before the Lord all the days of his life, who opens his lips to curse and abuse.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed is he who blesses all the Lord’s works.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Cursed is he who brings the Lord’s creation into contempt.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed is he who looks down and raises the fallen.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Cursed is he who looks to and is eager for the destruction of what is not his.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed is he who keeps the foundations of his fathers made firm from the beginning.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Cursed is he who perverts the decrees of his forefathers.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed is he who imparts peace and love.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Cursed is he who disturbs those that love their neighbours.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed is he who speaks with humble tongue and heart to all.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Cursed is he who speaks peace with his tongue, while in his heart there is no peace but a sword.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For all these things will be laid bare in the weighing-scales and in the books, on the day of the great judgment.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And now, my children, do not say: Our father is standing before God, and is praying for our sins, for there is there no helper of any man who has sinned.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: You see how I wrote all works of every man, before his creation, (all) that is done amongst all men for all time, and none can tell or relate my handwriting, because the Lord see all imaginings of man, how they are vain, where they lie in the treasure-houses of the heart.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And now, my children, mark well all the words of your father, that I tell you, lest you regret, saying: Why did our father not tell us?

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: At that time, not understanding this let these books which I have given you be for an inheritance of your peace.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Hand them to all who want them, and instruct them, that they may see the Lord’s very great and marvellous works.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: My children, behold, the day of my term and time have approached.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For the angels who shall go with me are standing before me and urge me to my departure from you; they are standing here on earth, awaiting what has been told them.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For to-morrow I shall go up on to heaven, to the uppermost Jerusalem to my eternal inheritance.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Therefore I bid you do before the Lord’s face all (his) good pleasure.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Mathosalam having answered his father Enoch, said: What is agreeable to your eyes, father, that I may make before your face, that you may bless our dwellings, and your sons, and that your people may be made glorious through you, and then (that) you may depart thus, as the Lord said?

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Enoch answered to his son Mathosalam (and) said: Hear, child, from the time when the Lord anointed me with the ointment of his glory, (there has been no) food in me, and my soul remembers not earthly enjoyment, neither do I want anything earthly.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: My child Methosalam, summon all your brethren and all your household and the elders of the people, that I may talk to them and depart, as is planned for me.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And Methosalam made haste, and summoned his brethren, Regim, Riman, Uchan, Chermion, Gaidad, and all the elders of the people before the face of his father Enoch; and he blessed them, (and) said to them:

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Listen to me, my children, to-day.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: In those days when the Lord came down on to earth for Adam’s sake, and visited all his creatures, which he created himself, after all these he created Adam, and the Lord called all the beasts of the earth, all the reptiles, and all the birds that soar in the air, and brought them all before the face of our father Adam.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And Adam gave the names to all things living on earth.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And the Lord appointed him ruler over all, and subjected to him all things under his hands, and made them dumb and made them dull that they be commanded of man, and be in subjection and obedience to him.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Thus also the Lord created every man lord over all his possessions.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: The Lord will not judge a single soul of beast for man’s sake, but adjudges the souls of men to their beasts in this world; for men have a special place.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And as every soul of man is according to number, similarly beasts will not perish, nor all souls of beasts which the Lord created, till the great judgment, and they will accuse man, if he feed them ill.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Whoever defiles the soul of beasts, defiles his own soul.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For man brings clean animals to make sacrifice for sin, that he may have cure of his soul.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And if they bring for sacrifice clean animals, and birds, man has cure, he cures his soul.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: All is given you for food, bind it by the four feet, that is to make good the cure, he cures his soul.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: But whoever kills beast without wounds, kills his own souls and defiles his own flesh.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And he who does any beast any injury whatsoever, in secret, it is evil practice, and he defiles his own soul.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: He who works the killing of a man’s soul, kills his own soul, and kills his own body, and there is no cure for him for all time.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: He who puts a man in any snare, shall stick in it himself, and there is no cure for him for all time.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: He who puts a man in any vessel, his retribution will not be wanting at the great judgment for all time.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: He who works crookedly or speaks evil against any soul, will not make justice for himself for all time.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And now, my children, keep your hearts from every injustice, which the Lord hates. Just as a man asks something for his own soul from God, so let him do to every living soul, because I know all things, how in the great time to come there is much inheritance prepared for men, good for the good, and bad for the bad, without number many.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed are those who enter the good houses, for in the bad houses there is no peace nor return from them.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Hear, my children, small and great! When man puts a good thought in his heart, brings gifts from his labours before the Lord’s face and his hands made them not, then the Lord will turn away his face from the labour of his hand, and (that) man cannot find the labour of his hands.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And if his hands made it, but his heart murmur, and his heart cease not making murmur incessantly, he has not any advantage.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed is the man who in his patience brings his gifts with faith before the Lord’s face, because he will find forgiveness of sins.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: But if he take back his words before the time, there is no repentance for him; and if the time pass and he do not of his own will what is promised, there is no repentance after death.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Because every work which man does before the time, is all deceit before men, and sin before God.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: When man clothes the naked and fills the hungry, he will find reward from God.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: But if his heart murmur, he commits a double evil; ruin of himself and of that which he gives; and for him there will be no finding of reward on account of that.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And if his own heart is filled with his food and his own flesh, clothed with his own clothing, he commits contempt, and will forfeit all his endurance of poverty, and will not find reward of his good deeds.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Every proud and magniloquent man is hateful to the Lord, and every false speech, clothed in untruth; it will be cut with the blade of the sword of death, and thrown into the fire, and shall burn for all time.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: When Enoch had spoken these words to his sons, all people far and near heard how the Lord was calling Enoch. They took counsel together:

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Let us go and kiss Enoch, and two thousand men came together and came to the place Achuzan where Enoch was, and his sons.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And the elders of the people, the whole assembly, came and bowed down and began to kiss Enoch and said to him:

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Our father Enoch, (may) you (be) blessed of the Lord, the eternal ruler, and now bless your sons and all the people, that we may be glorified to-day before your face.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For you shalt be glorified before the Lord’s face for all time, since the Lord chose you, rather than all men on earth, and designated you writer of all his creation, visible (physical) and invisible (spiritual), and redeemed of the sins of man, and helper of your household.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And Enoch answered all his people saying: Hear, my children, before that all creatures were created, the Lord created the visible (physical) and invisible (spiritual) things.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And as much time as there was and went past, understand that after all that he created man in the likeness of his own form, and put into him eyes to see, and ears to hear, and heart to reflect, and intellect wherewith to deliberate.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And the Lord saw all man’s works, and created all his creatures, and divided time, from time he fixed the years, and from the years he appointed the months, and from the months he appointed the days, and of days he appointed seven.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And in those he appointed the hours, measured them out exactly, that man might reflect on time and count years, months, and hours, (their) alternation, beginning, and end, and that he might count his own life, from the beginning until death, and reflect on his sin and write his work bad and good; because no work is hidden before the Lord, that every man might know his works and never transgress all his commandments, and keep my handwriting from generation to generation.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: When all creation visible (physical) and invisible (spiritual), as the Lord created it, shall end, then every man goes to the great judgment, and then all time shall perish, and the years, and thenceforward there will be neither months nor days nor hours, they will be adhered together and will not be counted.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: There will be one aeon, and all the righteous who shall escape the Lord’s great judgment, shall be collected in the great aeon, for the righteous the great aeon will begin, and they will live eternally, and then too there will be amongst them neither labour, nor sickness, nor humiliation, nor anxiety, nor need, nor brutality, nor night, nor darkness, but great light.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And they shall have a great indestructible wall, and a paradise bright and incorruptible (eternal), for all corruptible (mortal) things shall pass away, and there will be eternal life.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And now, my children, keep your souls from all injustice, such as the Lord hates.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Walk before his face with terror and trembling and serve him alone.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Bow down to the true God, not to dumb idols, but bow down to his similitude, and bring all just offerings before the Lord’s face. The Lord hates what is unjust.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For the Lord sees all things; when man takes thought in his heart, then he counsels the intellects, and every thought is always before the Lord, who made firm the earth and put all creatures on it.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: If you look to heaven, the Lord is there; if you take thought of the sea’s deep and all the under-earth, the Lord is there.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: For the Lord created all things. Bow not down to things made by man, leaving the Lord of all creation, because no work can remain hidden before the Lord’s face.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Walk, my children, in long-suffering, in meekness, honesty, in provocation, in grief, in faith and in truth, in (reliance on) promises, in illness, in abuse, in wounds, in temptation, in nakedness, in privation, loving one another, till you go out from this age of ills, that you become inheritors of endless time.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Blessed are the just who shall escape the great judgment, for they shall shine forth more than the sun sevenfold, for in this world the seventh part is taken off from all, light, darkness, food, enjoyment, sorrow, paradise, torture, fire, frost, and other things; he put all down in writing, that you might read and understand.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: When Enoch had talked to the people, the Lord sent out darkness on to the earth, and there was darkness, and it covered those men standing with Enoch, and they took Enoch up on to the highest heaven, where the Lord (is); and he received him and placed him before his face, and the darkness went off from the earth, and light came again.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And the people saw and understood not how Enoch had been taken, and glorified God, and found a roll in which was traced The Invisible (spiritual) God; and all went to their dwelling places.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Enoch was born on the sixth day of the month Tsivan, and lived three hundred and sixty-five years.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: He was taken up to heaven on the first day of the month Tsivan and remained in heaven sixty days.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: He wrote all these signs of all creation, which the Lord created, and wrote three hundred and sixty-six books, and handed them over to his sons and remained on earth thirty days, and was again taken up to heaven on the sixth day of the month Tsivan, on the very day and hour when he was born.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: As every man’s nature in this life is dark, so are also his conception, birth, and departure from this life.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: At what hour he was conceived, at that hour he was born, and at that hour too he died.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Methosalam and his brethren, all the sons of Enoch, made haste, and erected an altar at that place called Achuzan, whence and where Enoch had been taken up to heaven.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And they took sacrificial oxen and summoned all people and sacrificed the sacrifice before the Lord’s face.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: All people, the elders of the people and the whole assembly came to the feast and brought gifts to the sons of Enoch.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: And they made a great feast, rejoicing and making merry three days, praising God, who had given them such a sign through Enoch, who had found favour with him, and that they should hand it on to their sons from generation to generation, from age to age.

title: 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch)
text: Amen.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Había un hombre sabio, gran artífice; el Señor lo amó y lo recibió para que contemplara las moradas supremas y fuera testigo del reino sabio, grande, inconcebible e inmutable de Dios todopoderoso; de la estación maravillosa, gloriosa, resplandeciente y omnividente de los siervos del Señor; del trono inaccesible del Señor; de los grados y manifestaciones de las huestes incorpóreas; del inefable servicio de la multitud de las criaturas; del aspecto cambiante y del canto indescriptible de las huestes de querubines, y de la luz sin límites.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Entonces dijo: «Cuando cumplí ciento sesenta y cinco años, engendré a mi hijo Matusalén».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Después de esto viví doscientos años y completé trescientos sesenta y cinco años de toda mi vida.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: El primer día del mes estaba solo en mi casa; descansaba en mi lecho y dormí.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Mientras dormía, una gran aflicción se apoderó de mi corazón; lloraba en sueños y no podía comprender qué significaba aquella aflicción ni qué habría de sucederme.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Entonces aparecieron ante mí dos hombres extraordinariamente altos, como jamás había visto en la tierra. Sus rostros brillaban como el sol; sus ojos eran como lámparas ardientes; de sus labios salía fuego. Sus vestiduras y su canto eran de diversos tipos y de color púrpura; sus alas resplandecían más que el oro y sus manos eran más blancas que la nieve.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Se situaron a la cabecera de mi lecho y empezaron a llamarme por mi nombre.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Me desperté y vi claramente a aquellos dos hombres delante de mí.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Los saludé, pero el temor se apoderó de mí y mi rostro cambió por el terror. Entonces aquellos hombres me dijeron:

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: «Ten ánimo, Enoc; no temas. El Dios eterno nos ha enviado a ti y hoy subirás con nosotros al cielo. Dirás a tus hijos y a toda tu casa lo que deberán hacer en la tierra mientras estés ausente; y que nadie te busque hasta que el Señor te devuelva a ellos».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Me apresuré a obedecerlos; salí de mi casa y llegué a las puertas, como se me había ordenado. Llamé a mis hijos Matusalén, Regim y Gaidal, y les di a conocer todas las maravillas que aquellos hombres me habían dicho.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Escuchadme, hijos míos: no sé adónde voy ni qué me sucederá. Por eso os digo: no os apartéis de Dios para seguir a los ídolos vanos, que no hicieron el cielo ni la tierra; ellos y quienes los adoran perecerán. Que el Señor fortalezca vuestros corazones en su temor. Y ahora, hijos míos, que nadie piense en buscarme hasta que el Señor me devuelva a vosotros.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Cuando Enoc terminó de hablar a sus hijos, los ángeles lo tomaron sobre sus alas, lo llevaron al primer cielo y lo colocaron sobre las nubes. Allí miré; volví a mirar hacia lo alto y vi el éter. Me situaron en el primer cielo y me mostraron un mar inmenso, mayor que el mar de la tierra.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Pusieron ante mí a los ancianos y gobernantes de los órdenes estelares, y me mostraron doscientos ángeles que rigen las estrellas y su servicio en los cielos; vuelan con sus alas y recorren a quienes navegan.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Miré hacia abajo y vi los depósitos de la nieve, a los ángeles que guardan sus terribles almacenes y a las nubes de donde salen y adonde regresan.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Me mostraron el depósito del rocío, semejante al aceite de oliva, y el aspecto de su forma, como el de todas las flores de la tierra; vi además muchos ángeles que guardaban estos depósitos y cómo se les mandaba abrirlos y cerrarlos.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Aquellos hombres me llevaron al segundo cielo y me mostraron una oscuridad mayor que la de la tierra. Allí vi prisioneros suspendidos y vigilados, a la espera del juicio grande e ilimitado; aquellos ángeles o espíritus tenían aspecto más oscuro que la oscuridad terrenal y lloraban sin cesar a toda hora.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Pregunté a los hombres que estaban conmigo: «¿Por qué son atormentados sin cesar?». Ellos me respondieron: «Estos son los apóstatas de Dios, que no obedecieron sus mandamientos, sino que siguieron su propia voluntad y se apartaron con su príncipe, que también está encadenado en el quinto cielo».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Sentí gran compasión por ellos. Me saludaron y dijeron: «Hombre de Dios, ruega por nosotros al Señor». Yo les respondí: «¿Quién soy yo, un hombre mortal, para rogar por ángeles o espíritus? ¿Quién sabe adónde voy o qué me sucederá? ¿Y quién rogará por mí?».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Aquellos hombres me llevaron de allí al tercer cielo y me colocaron en él. Miré hacia abajo y vi los frutos de aquellos lugares, de una bondad jamás conocida.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Vi todos los árboles de dulce floración y contemplé sus frutos fragantes, y todos los alimentos que producían exhalaban un aroma delicioso.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: En medio de los árboles estaba el árbol de la vida, en el lugar donde el Señor descansa cuando entra en el paraíso. Ese árbol tenía una bondad y una fragancia inefables; estaba adornado más que cualquier cosa creada y, por todos lados, parecía de oro, bermellón y fuego. Lo cubría todo y producía toda clase de frutos.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Su raíz está en el jardín, en el extremo de la tierra.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: El paraíso se encuentra entre la corrupción y la incorruptibilidad.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: De allí brotan dos fuentes que manan miel y leche; de ellas fluyen aceite y vino. Se dividen en cuatro corrientes, recorren su camino apaciblemente y descienden al paraíso de Edén, entre la corrupción y la incorruptibilidad.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Desde allí se extienden por la tierra y completan su curso circular, como los demás elementos.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Allí no hay árbol estéril y todo lugar es bendito.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Trescientos ángeles resplandecientes guardan el jardín y, con canto dulce e incesante y voces que nunca callan, sirven al Señor en todos los días y horas.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Dije: «¡Qué dulce es este lugar!». Y aquellos hombres me dijeron:

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: «Este lugar, Enoc, está preparado para los justos: para quienes soportan toda ofensa de los que afligen sus almas; apartan sus ojos de la maldad; juzgan con justicia; dan pan al hambriento; visten al desnudo; levantan al caído; socorren a los huérfanos heridos; caminan sin falta ante el rostro del Señor y le sirven solo a él. Para ellos está preparado este lugar como herencia eterna».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Aquellos dos hombres me llevaron hacia el norte y me mostraron un lugar espantoso. Allí había toda clase de tormentos: oscuridad cruel y tinieblas sin luz; un fuego sombrío que ardía sin cesar; un río de fuego; y todo el lugar era fuego. Por todas partes había escarcha y hielo, sed y estremecimiento; las cadenas eran terribles, y los ángeles o espíritus, temibles e implacables, llevaban instrumentos de castigo. Entonces dije:

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: «¡Ay, ay! ¡Qué terrible es este lugar!».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Aquellos hombres me dijeron: «Este lugar, Enoc, está preparado para quienes deshonran a Dios; para quienes en la tierra practican pecados contra la naturaleza, corrupción de menores al modo sodomita, magia, encantamientos y hechicería diabólica; para quienes se glorían de sus malas obras: robo, mentira, calumnia, envidia, rencor, fornicación y asesinato; para quienes, malditos, arrebatan las almas de los hombres; para quienes, al ver a los pobres, les quitan sus bienes y se enriquecen con los bienes ajenos; para quienes, pudiendo alimentar al necesitado, dejaron morir al hambriento; pudiendo vestirlo, desnudaron al que no tenía ropa; para quienes no conocieron a su Creador, se inclinaron ante dioses sin alma ni vida, incapaces de ver u oír, fabricaron imágenes talladas y adoraron obras impuras hechas por manos humanas. Para todos ellos está preparado este lugar como herencia eterna».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Aquellos hombres me llevaron al cuarto cielo y me mostraron todos los recorridos sucesivos y todos los rayos de luz del sol y de la luna.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Medí sus recorridos, comparé su luz y vi que la luz del sol es mayor que la de la luna.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Su órbita y las ruedas sobre las que se desplaza avanzan sin descanso, con velocidad admirable, como el viento que pasa.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Cuatro grandes estrellas acompañan su salida y su regreso; cada una tiene bajo su mando mil estrellas a la derecha de la rueda solar, y otras cuatro se hallan a la izquierda, también con mil estrellas cada una: en total, ocho mil que salen continuamente con el sol.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Durante el día lo acompañan ciento cincuenta mil ángeles y durante la noche, mil.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Seres de seis alas marchan con los ángeles delante de la rueda solar, entre llamas de fuego; cien ángeles encienden el sol y lo mantienen encendido.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Miré y vi otras criaturas aladas del sol, llamadas Fénixes y Calcídrios, maravillosas y admirables; tenían pies y colas semejantes a los de un león y cabeza de cocodrilo. Su aspecto era púrpura como el arcoíris; medían novecientas medidas; sus alas eran como las de los ángeles, doce cada una. Acompañan al sol, llevando calor y rocío, según lo que Dios les ha ordenado.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Así el sol gira, avanza y sale bajo el cielo; su curso continúa bajo la tierra con la luz de sus rayos sin cesar.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Aquellos hombres me llevaron hacia el oriente y me colocaron junto a las puertas del sol, por donde este sale según el orden de las estaciones, el curso de los meses del año entero y el cómputo de las horas del día y de la noche.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Vi seis puertas abiertas; cada una medía sesenta y un estadios y un cuarto de estadio. Las medí con exactitud y comprendí su tamaño: por ellas sale el sol, se dirige al occidente, se iguala y vuelve a salir durante todos los meses; regresa por las seis puertas según la sucesión de las estaciones. Así se completa el año entero tras el retorno de las cuatro estaciones.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: De nuevo aquellos hombres me llevaron hacia occidente y me mostraron seis grandes puertas abiertas, correspondientes a las puertas orientales, frente al lugar por donde se pone el sol, según los trescientos sesenta y cinco días y un cuarto.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Por ellas vuelve a descender al occidente y retira su luz y el esplendor de su brillo bajo la tierra. La corona de su resplandor permanece en el cielo con el Señor, guardada por cuatrocientos ángeles; mientras tanto, el sol gira bajo tierra y permanece siete grandes horas en la noche. Cuando llega al acceso oriental en la octava hora nocturna, lleva consigo sus luces y su corona resplandeciente, y brilla con más fuerza que el fuego.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Entonces las criaturas del sol, llamadas Fénixes y Calcídrios, prorrumpen en canto; por ello cada ave agita sus alas, alegrándose ante el dador de luz, y canta por mandato del Señor.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: El dador de luz viene a iluminar el mundo entero; aparece la guardia de la mañana, que son los rayos del sol. El sol de la tierra sale, recibe su brillo para alumbrar toda la faz de la tierra, y me mostraron este cálculo de su recorrido.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Las puertas por las que entra son las grandes puertas que calculan las horas del año; por ello el sol es una gran creación, cuyo ciclo dura veintiocho años y vuelve a comenzar desde el principio.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Aquellos hombres me mostraron el otro curso, el de la luna: doce grandes puertas coronadas, de occidente a oriente, por las cuales la luna entra y sale en sus tiempos acostumbrados.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Entra por la primera puerta hacia las regiones occidentales del sol durante treinta y un días; por la segunda, treinta y un días; por la tercera, treinta; por la cuarta, treinta; por la quinta, treinta y uno; por la sexta, treinta y uno; por la séptima, treinta; por la octava, treinta y uno; por la novena, treinta y uno; por la décima, treinta; por la undécima, treinta y uno; y por la duodécima, veintiocho días.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Recorre las puertas occidentales siguiendo el orden y número de las orientales y completa los trescientos sesenta y cinco días y un cuarto del año solar. El año lunar tiene trescientos cincuenta y cuatro días; le faltan doce días respecto del ciclo solar, que son las epactas lunares del año entero.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Del mismo modo, el gran ciclo comprende quinientos treinta y dos años.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: El cuarto de día se omite durante tres años; el cuarto año lo completa exactamente.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Por eso se los deja fuera del cielo durante tres años y no se los añade al número de los días, pues alteran el cómputo de los años: dos meses se añaden para completar y otros dos se reducen.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Cuando termina el recorrido de las puertas occidentales, vuelve hacia oriente, hacia las luces; recorre así, día y noche, los círculos celestes, más bajo que todos ellos y más veloz que los vientos del cielo, los espíritus, los elementos y los ángeles que vuelan. Cada ángel tiene seis alas.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Su recorrido se repite siete veces en diecinueve años.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: En medio de los cielos vi tropas armadas que servían al Señor con tímpanos y órganos, con voces incesantes y dulces, y con un canto variado imposible de describir. Tan admirable y maravilloso era el canto de aquellos ángeles que maravillaba a toda mente, y yo me deleité al escucharlo.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Los hombres me llevaron al quinto cielo y me colocaron allí. Vi muchas tropas innumerables llamadas Grigori, de aspecto humano; eran mayores que los gigantes, tenían el rostro marchito, guardaban perpetuo silencio y no había servicio en el quinto cielo. Entonces pregunté a los hombres que estaban conmigo:

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: «¿Por qué están tan marchitos, por qué sus rostros son tristes y sus bocas permanecen calladas? ¿Por qué no hay servicio en este cielo?».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Ellos me respondieron: «Estos son los Grigori que, con su príncipe Satanail, rechazaron al Señor de la luz. Después de ellos están los que permanecen en gran oscuridad en el segundo cielo. Tres de ellos descendieron de junto al trono del Señor al lugar de Hermón, quebrantaron sus juramentos en las laderas del monte Hermón, vieron que las hijas de los hombres eran hermosas, tomaron mujeres para sí y contaminaron la tierra con sus obras. Durante toda su época practicaron la iniquidad y la mezcla; de ellos nacieron gigantes, hombres de tamaño prodigioso y gran enemistad».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Por eso Dios los juzgó con gran juicio; lloran por sus hermanos y serán castigados en el gran día del Señor.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Dije a los Grigori: «He visto a vuestros hermanos, sus obras y sus grandes tormentos; rogué por ellos, pero el Señor los ha condenado a permanecer bajo tierra hasta que el cielo y la tierra actuales terminen para siempre».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y les dije: «¿Por qué esperáis, hermanos, y no servís ante el rostro del Señor ni presentáis vuestro servicio ante él, para no provocar por completo la ira de vuestro Señor?».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Escucharon mi exhortación y hablaron a los cuatro órdenes del cielo. Y he aquí que, mientras yo estaba con aquellos dos hombres, cuatro trompetas sonaron a una gran voz; los Grigori comenzaron a cantar al unísono, y su voz subió ante el Señor de manera lastimera y conmovedora.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Desde allí aquellos hombres me llevaron al sexto cielo. Vi siete órdenes de ángeles, resplandecientes y gloriosos; sus rostros brillaban más que el sol y no había diferencia entre sus rostros, conducta o vestiduras. Ellos establecen los órdenes, estudian los movimientos de las estrellas, los cambios de la luna, el curso del sol y el buen gobierno del mundo.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Cuando ven el mal, imparten mandamientos e instrucción, y elevan cantos dulces, fuertes y de alabanza.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Estos son los arcángeles, superiores a los ángeles; miden toda vida en el cielo y en la tierra. También están los ángeles encargados de las estaciones y los años, de los ríos y el mar, de los frutos de la tierra y de cada hierba que alimenta a todo ser vivo; y los ángeles que escriben ante el rostro del Señor las almas de los hombres, sus obras y sus vidas. En medio de ellos hay seis Fénixes, seis Querubines y seis seres de seis alas que cantan continuamente a una sola voz; es imposible describir su canto, y se alegran ante el estrado del Señor.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Aquellos dos hombres me elevaron al séptimo cielo. Allí vi una luz inmensa y tropas ardientes de grandes arcángeles, potestades incorpóreas, dominios, órdenes y gobiernos, querubines, serafines, tronos y seres de muchos ojos, nueve regimientos y las estaciones luminosas de los Ioanitas. Tuve miedo y comencé a temblar de gran terror; entonces aquellos hombres me tomaron y me guiaron.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Me dijeron: «Ten ánimo, Enoc; no temas». Y me mostraron de lejos al Señor, sentado en su trono altísimo. Pues, ¿qué hay en el décimo cielo, donde habita el Señor?

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: En el décimo cielo está Dios; en lengua hebrea se lo llama Aravot.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Todas las huestes celestiales llegaban y se situaban en los diez escalones conforme a su rango; se inclinaban ante el Señor y volvían a sus lugares con gozo y felicidad, cantando con voces suaves en la luz sin límites y sirviéndolo gloriosamente.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Los querubines y serafines que rodean el trono, los seres de seis alas y los de muchos ojos, no se apartan: permanecen ante el rostro del Señor cumpliendo su voluntad y cubren todo su trono, cantando suavemente: «Santo, santo, santo, Señor, soberano de Sabaot; los cielos y la tierra están llenos de tu gloria».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Cuando vi todo esto, aquellos hombres me dijeron: «Enoc, hasta aquí se nos ha mandado viajar contigo». Entonces se alejaron de mí y no los volví a ver.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Me quedé solo al final del séptimo cielo; tuve miedo, caí rostro en tierra y dije para mí: «¡Ay de mí! ¿Qué me ha sucedido?».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: El Señor envió a uno de sus gloriosos, el arcángel Gabriel, quien me dijo: «Ten ánimo, Enoc; no temas. Levántate ante el rostro del Señor para la eternidad; levántate y ven conmigo».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Respondí en mi interior: «Señor mío, mi alma ha desfallecido de terror y temblor. Llamé a los hombres que me condujeron hasta este lugar; en ellos confiaba, y con ellos iré ante el rostro del Señor».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Gabriel me tomó como una hoja que el viento arrebata y me puso ante el rostro del Señor.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Vi el octavo cielo, llamado en hebreo Muzalot, el cambiador de las estaciones, de la sequía y de la humedad, y de las doce constelaciones del círculo del firmamento que están por encima del séptimo cielo.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Vi el noveno cielo, llamado en hebreo Kuchavim, donde se encuentran las moradas celestiales de las doce constelaciones del círculo del firmamento.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: En el décimo cielo, llamado Aravot, vi el aspecto del rostro del Señor: era como hierro puesto al rojo vivo y sacado del fuego, que despide chispas y arde.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Así, en un instante de eternidad, vi el rostro del Señor; pero su rostro es inefable, maravilloso, imponente y terriblemente temible.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: ¿Quién soy yo para hablar del ser indecible del Señor y de su rostro maravilloso? No puedo describir la multitud de sus instrucciones ni la diversidad de sus voces; su trono es inmenso y no hecho por manos, ni puedo contar las huestes de querubines y serafines que lo rodean, su canto incesante, su belleza inmutable o la grandeza inefable de su gloria.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Caí postrado y adoré al Señor. Entonces el Señor me dijo con sus labios:

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: «Ten ánimo, Enoc; no temas. Levántate y permanece ante mi rostro para la eternidad».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: El arcángel Miguel me levantó y me condujo ante el rostro del Señor.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: El Señor dijo a sus siervos, poniéndolos a prueba: «Que Enoc permanezca ante mi rostro para la eternidad». Los gloriosos se inclinaron ante el Señor y dijeron: «Que Enoc vaya conforme a tu palabra».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: El Señor dijo a Miguel: «Ve, quita a Enoc sus vestiduras terrenales, úngelo con mi dulce óleo y vístelo con las vestiduras de mi gloria».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Miguel hizo como el Señor le había ordenado: me ungió y me vistió. El aspecto de aquel óleo era más brillante que la gran luz; era como dulce rocío, su aroma era suave y resplandecía como el rayo del sol. Me miré y era semejante a uno de sus seres gloriosos.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: El Señor llamó a uno de sus arcángeles, Pravuil, cuya sabiduría era más rápida que la de los demás arcángeles y que escribía todas las obras del Señor. Y le dijo: «Saca de mis tesoros los libros y una pluma de escritura veloz; dáselos a Enoc y entrégale de tu mano los libros escogidos y consoladores».

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y él me estaba diciendo todas las obras del cielo, la tierra y el mar, y todos los elementos, sus pasajes y sus marchas, y los truenos de los truenos, el sol y la luna, las marchas y cambios de las estrellas, las estaciones, los años, los días y las horas, las subidas del viento, los números de los ángeles, y la formación de sus canciones, y todas las cosas humanas, la lengua de cada canción y vida

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y Pravuil me dijo: Todas las cosas que te dijo, hemos escrito. Siéntate y escribe todas las almas de la humanidad, sin embargo muchos de ellos nacen, y los lugares apropiados para ellos hasta la ceremonia; porque todas las almas están preparadas para la celebración, antes de la formación del mundo.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y todo el doble treinta días y treinta noches, y escrito todas las cosas exactamente, y escrito trescientos sesenta y seis libros.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y el Señor me llamó, y me dijo: Enoc, sentarse a mi izquierda con Gabriel.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y me incliné hacia el Señor, y el Señor me habló: Enoc, amado, todo (que) ustedes ven, todas las cosas que están de pie terminadas les digo incluso antes del comienzo mismo, todo lo que yo creé de no ser, y cosas visibles (físicas) de invisible (espiritual).

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Oíd, Enoc, y tomad estas mis palabras, porque no a Mis ángeles él dijo mi secreto, y no les él dicho su avance, ni mi reino infinito, ni han comprendido mi creación, que os digo hoy.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Porque antes de que todas las cosas fueran visibles (físicas), yo solo solía hacer cosas invisibles (espirituales), como el sol de este a oeste, y de oeste a este.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Pero incluso el sol tiene paz en sí mismo, mientras que no encontré paz, porque estaba creando todas las cosas, y concebí el pensamiento de colocar cimientos, y de crear creación visible (física).

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Mandé en el más bajo (partes), que las cosas visibles (físicas) deben descender de invisible (espiritual), y Adoil descendió muy grande, y lo miré, y he here! Tenía un vientre de gran luz.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y yo le dije: Deshacerse, Adoil, y dejar que el visible (físico) (venga) fuera de usted.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y vino desapercibido, y salió una gran luz. Y yo (fue) en medio de la gran luz, y como nace la luz de la luz, salió una gran edad, y mostró toda la creación, que había pensado crear.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y vi que estaba bien.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y poner para mí un trono, y tomé mi asiento sobre él, y dije a la luz: Ve allí arriba y ponte alto sobre el trono, y sé un fundamento para las cosas más altas.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
text: Y sobre la luz no hay nada más, y luego me incliné y miré desde mi trono.

title: 2 Enoc (Libro de los Secretos de Enoc)
